function PianoUI.updateVolumeSliderVisuals()
    volume = math.clamp(volume, 0, 1)
    local volumePrefix = PianoUI.mobilePortraitLayout and "VOL " or (scale.Scale < 0.62 and "VOL " or "ÂM LƯỢNG ")
    volumeLabel.Text = volumePrefix .. tostring(math.floor(volume * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
    PianoUI.volumeSliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(volume, 0, 1, 0)
    -- Keep the knob fully inside the track at both 0% and 100%.
    PianoUI.volumeSliderKnob.Position = UDim2.new(volume, 7 - (14 * volume), 0.5, 0)
end
function PianoUI.applyMasterVolume()
    PianoUI.updateVolumeSliderVisuals()
    for _, snd in pairs(sounds) do
        if snd and snd.Parent then
            if snd == metronomeSound then
                snd.Volume = volume * 0.22
            else
                snd.Volume = effectiveVoiceVolume(voiceState.velocities[snd], voiceState.semitones[snd])
            end
        end
    end
end
function PianoUI.setVolumeFromPointer(pointerX)
    local width = PianoUI.volumeSliderTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
    if width <= 0 then return end
    local left = PianoUI.volumeSliderTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
    local inset = math.min(7, width * 0.08)
    volume = math.clamp((pointerX - left - inset) / math.max(width - (inset * 2), 1), 0, 1)
    volume = math.floor(volume * 100 + 0.5) / 100
    PianoUI.applyMasterVolume()
end
function PianoUI.beginVolumeDrag(input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
    end
    PianoUI.volumeSliderDragging = true
    PianoUI.setVolumeFromPointer(input.Position.X)
end
PianoUI.volumeSliderTrack.InputBegan:Connect(PianoUI.beginVolumeDrag)
PianoUI.volumeSliderKnob.InputBegan:Connect(PianoUI.beginVolumeDrag)
trackLifetimeConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if PianoUI.volumeSliderDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        PianoUI.setVolumeFromPointer(input.Position.X)
    end
end))
trackLifetimeConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        PianoUI.volumeSliderDragging = false
    end
end))
PianoUI.updateVolumeSliderVisuals()

PianoUI.controlsHidden = false
minimize.Activated:Connect(function()
    PianoUI.controlsHidden = not PianoUI.controlsHidden
    controlPanelVisible = not PianoUI.controlsHidden
    local showControls = not PianoUI.controlsHidden
    controls.Visible = showControls and viewMode == "classic"
    instrumentControls.Visible = showControls and viewMode == "classic"
    autoPanel.Visible = showControls and viewMode == "classic"
    status.Visible = showControls
    volumeLabel.Visible = showControls
    PianoUI.volumeSliderTrack.Visible = showControls
    if PianoUI.fitToScreen then PianoUI.fitToScreen() end
    minimize.Text = PianoUI.mobilePortraitLayout and (PianoUI.controlsHidden and "NÚT+" or "NÚT") or (scale.Scale < 0.62 and (PianoUI.controlsHidden and "NÚT+" or "NÚT") or (PianoUI.controlsHidden and "HIỆN NÚT" or "ẨN NÚT"))
    minimize.BackgroundColor3 = PianoUI.controlsHidden and Color3.fromRGB(113, 82, 39) or Color3.fromRGB(63, 49, 32)
end)

hidePianoBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    -- Hide the full instrument case and its shadow. Audio playback is retained.
    main.Visible = false
    mainShadow.Visible = false
    restorePianoBtn.Visible = true
end)

restorePianoBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = true
    mainShadow.Visible = true
    restorePianoBtn.Visible = false
end)

close.Activated:Connect(function()
    stopPlayback(false)
    isRecording = false
    metronomeEnabled = false
    metronomeToken += 1
    metronomeLoopGeneration += 1
    for _, record in pairs(activeInputVoices) do if record then releaseManualVoice(record) end end
    for _, record in pairs(activeKeyboardVoices) do if record then releaseManualVoice(record) end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

PianoUI.keyToNote = {}
PianoUI.keyboardCodeLayout = {
    "Z", "S", "X", "D", "C", "V", "G", "B", "H", "N", "J", "M",
    "Q", "Two", "W", "Three", "E", "R", "Five", "T", "Six", "Y", "Seven", "U",
    "I", "Nine", "O", "Zero", "P", "One", "A", "Four", "F", "Eight", "K", "L", "Minus",
}
for index, codeName in ipairs(PianoUI.keyboardCodeLayout) do
    local note = PianoUI.notesBySemi[index - 1] -- PC bindings stay on C3-C6 for familiarity.
    if codeName and note then PianoUI.keyToNote[codeName] = note end
end

trackLifetimeConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed or not gui.Parent or not main.Visible then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        if autoBox and autoBox:IsFocused() then return end
        local codeName = input.KeyCode.Name
        local note = PianoUI.keyToNote[codeName]
        if note and not activeKeyboardVoices[codeName] then
            local snd = playNote(note, "manual")
            activeKeyboardVoices[codeName] = {note = note, sound = snd, recordEvent = snd and voiceState.recordedEvents[snd]}
        end
    end
end))

trackLifetimeConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    local touchRecord = activeInputVoices[input]
    if touchRecord then
        activeInputVoices[input] = nil
        releaseManualVoice(touchRecord)
    end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        local codeName = input.KeyCode.Name
        local record = activeKeyboardVoices[codeName]
        if record then
            activeKeyboardVoices[codeName] = nil
            releaseManualVoice(record)
        end
    end
end))

-- Responsive full-screen grand-piano layout. The keybed is anchored to the bottom
-- edge and always keeps its own lane; controls reflow above it rather than overlap.
PianoUI.camera = nil
PianoUI.cameraConnection = nil
PianoUI.setMobilePage = function(page)
    local valid = { ["CHƠI"] = true, ["BẢN NHẠC"] = true, ["HỢP ÂM"] = true, ["METRONOME"] = true, ["THU ÂM"] = true }
    if not valid[page] then return end
    PianoUI.mobilePage = page
    if PianoUI.fitToScreen then PianoUI.fitToScreen() end
end
PianoUI.mobilePlayTab.Activated:Connect(function() PianoUI.setMobilePage("CHƠI") end)
PianoUI.mobileSongTab.Activated:Connect(function() PianoUI.setMobilePage("BẢN NHẠC") end)
PianoUI.mobileChordTab.Activated:Connect(function() PianoUI.setMobilePage("HỢP ÂM") end)
PianoUI.mobileMetronomeTab.Activated:Connect(function() PianoUI.setMobilePage("METRONOME") end)
PianoUI.mobileRecordTab.Activated:Connect(function() PianoUI.setMobilePage("THU ÂM") end)

PianoUI.fitToScreen = function()
    local viewport
    if PianoUI.camera then
        viewport = PianoUI.camera.ViewportSize
    else
        viewport = gui.AbsoluteSize
    end
    if not viewport or viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 then return end

    local touch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
    local portrait = touch and viewport.Y > viewport.X
    local aspectRatio = viewport.Y > 0 and viewport.X / viewport.Y or 1
    local compactLandscape = (not portrait) and aspectRatio >= 1.85
    local compactPortrait = portrait
    local mobileLandscape = touch and not portrait
    PianoUI.mobilePortraitLayout = portrait or compactLandscape
    local screenW, screenH = viewport.X, viewport.Y
    local mainW = math.max(280, screenW - 12)
    local mainH = math.max(320, screenH - 12)
    local cw = math.max(250, mainW - 28)

    sizeConstraint.MinSize = Vector2.new(math.min(280, mainW), math.min(320, mainH))
    sizeConstraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(4096, 2160)
    main.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    main.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12)
    scale.Scale = 1
    shadowScale.Scale = 1
    mainShadow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    mainShadow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4)
    mainShadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0.5, 9)

    header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
    headerCover.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -14)
    headerCover.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
    headerSeparator.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 50)
    headerSeparator.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1)
    headerGlow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 51)
    headerGlow.Size = UDim2.new(0.34, 0, 0, 1)

    content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 58)
    content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -72)

    -- Brand strip and window actions. On landscape phones, leave the Roblox top-left
    -- system controls clear instead of drawing our brand underneath them.
    local brandX = mobileLandscape and math.min(430, math.max(250, math.floor(screenW * 0.30))) or (compactPortrait and 14 or 17)
    title.Visible = not (mobileLandscape and screenW < 1000)
    title.Text = "♬  DUNGDX"
    title.Position = UDim2.new(0, brandX, 0, 0)
    title.Size = UDim2.new(0, mobileLandscape and 145 or (compactPortrait and 120 or 176), 1, 0)
    title.TextSize = mobileLandscape and 14 or (compactPortrait and 14 or 17)
    subtitle.Visible = not compactPortrait and screenW > 1000
    local subtitleX = mobileLandscape and (brandX + 148) or 204
    subtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, compactPortrait and 126 or subtitleX, 0, 0)
    subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(subtitleX + 285), 1, 0)
    subtitle.Text = "GRAND PIANO  •  75 KEYS  •  A0–B6"
    subtitle.TextSize = screenW > 1100 and 10 or 9
    local actionY = 8
    if compactPortrait then
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(minimize, UDim2.new(1, -143, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 31))
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(hidePianoBtn, UDim2.new(1, -94, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 31))
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(close, UDim2.new(1, -43, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 31))
        minimize.Text, hidePianoBtn.Text = "NÚT", "ẨN"
    elseif mobileLandscape then
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(minimize, UDim2.new(1, -218, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 30))
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(hidePianoBtn, UDim2.new(1, -144, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 30))
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(close, UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 30))
        minimize.Text = PianoUI.controlsHidden and "NÚT +" or "NÚT"
        hidePianoBtn.Text = "ĐÀN"
    else
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(minimize, UDim2.new(1, -260, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 91, 0, 32))
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(hidePianoBtn, UDim2.new(1, -158, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 91, 0, 32))
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(close, UDim2.new(1, -51, 0, actionY), UDim2.new(0, 39, 0, 32))
        minimize.Text = PianoUI.controlsHidden and "HIỆN NÚT" or "ẨN NÚT"
        hidePianoBtn.Text = "ẨN ĐÀN"
    end

    local wide = not compactPortrait and cw >= 760
    local hidden = PianoUI.controlsHidden
    local classic = viewMode == "classic"
    local showUi = not hidden and classic
    local statusY = 0
    status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, statusY)
    status.Size = UDim2.new(1, wide and -350 or -176, 0, 23)
    status.TextXAlignment = compactPortrait and Enum.TextXAlignment.Center or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    status.TextSize = compactPortrait and 9 or 11
    status.Visible = not hidden

    local volumeLabelWidth = compactPortrait and 65 or 108
    local sliderWidth = compactPortrait and math.max(64, math.min(100, cw * 0.26)) or math.max(92, math.min(150, cw * 0.14))
    local rightReserve = volumeLabelWidth + sliderWidth + 20
    volumeLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -rightReserve, 0, 0)
    volumeLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, volumeLabelWidth, 0, 23)
    volumeLabel.Text = (compactPortrait and "VOL " or "ÂM LƯỢNG ") .. tostring(math.floor(volume * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
    volumeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    volumeLabel.TextSize = compactPortrait and 9 or 11
    volumeLabel.Visible = not hidden
    PianoUI.volumeSliderTrack.Position = UDim2.new(1, -sliderWidth, 0, 9)
    PianoUI.volumeSliderTrack.Size = UDim2.new(0, sliderWidth - 8, 0, 6)
    PianoUI.volumeSliderKnob.Size = UDim2.new(0, compactPortrait and 13 or 16, 0, compactPortrait and 13 or 16)
    PianoUI.volumeSliderTrack.Visible = not hidden
    if PianoUI.updateVolumeSliderVisuals then PianoUI.updateVolumeSliderVisuals() end

    -- Playback row; compact portrait gets a second speed row so labels remain tappable.
    controls.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 27)
    local playbackButtons = {playBtn, pauseBtn, stopBtn, recordBtn, replayBtn}
    local playbackHeight = compactPortrait and 29 or (mobileLandscape and 29 or 33)
    controls.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, compactPortrait and 59 or (mobileLandscape and 30 or 33))
    local playbackGap = compactPortrait and 3 or 6
    local speedGapWide = 4
    local speedWWide = math.max(42, math.min(92, math.floor((cw * 0.42 - 58 - speedGapWide * 4) / 5)))
    local speedGroupWWide = 54 + speedGapWide + speedWWide * 5 + speedGapWide * 4
    -- Give playback buttons the remaining lane beside the speed selector. The old
    -- 43%-width cap forced landscape-mobile buttons down to icon-only labels.
    local playbackAreaW = compactPortrait and cw or math.min(cw * 0.58, math.max(240, cw - speedGroupWWide - 18))
    local playbackW = math.floor((playbackAreaW - playbackGap * (#playbackButtons - 1)) / #playbackButtons)
    for i, button in ipairs(playbackButtons) do
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(button, UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * (playbackW + playbackGap), 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, playbackW, 0, playbackHeight))
        button.TextSize = compactPortrait and 10 or (playbackW >= 100 and 11 or 9)
    end
    if compactPortrait then
        playBtn.Text = "▶ PHÁT"
        pauseBtn.Text = paused and "▶ TIẾP" or "Ⅱ DỪNG"
        stopBtn.Text = "■"
        recordBtn.Text = isRecording and "● REC" or "● THU"
        replayBtn.Text = "↻ LẠI"
        speedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34)
        speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 25)
        speedLabel.Text = "TỐC ĐỘ"
        speedLabel.TextSize = 9
        local speedGap = 4
        local speedW = math.max(37, math.min(52, math.floor((cw - 60 - speedGap * 4) / 5)))
        local speedGroupW = speedW * 5 + speedGap * 4
        local speedStart = math.max(50, (cw - speedGroupW) * 0.5 + 21)
        for i, button in ipairs(PianoUI.speedButtons) do
            PianoUI.setButtonLayout(button, UDim2.new(0, speedStart + (i - 1) * (speedW + speedGap), 0, 34), UDim2.new(0, speedW, 0, 25))
            button.Text = ({"0.5×", "0.75×", "1×", "1.25×", "1.5×"})[i]
            button.TextSize = 9
        end
    else
        local labelsAllowed = playbackW >= 88
        playBtn.Text = labelsAllowed and "▶ PHÁT" or "▶"
        pauseBtn.Text = labelsAllowed and (paused and "▶ TIẾP TỤC" or "Ⅱ TẠM DỪNG") or (paused and "▶" or "Ⅱ")
        stopBtn.Text = labelsAllowed and "■ DỪNG" or "■"
        recordBtn.Text = labelsAllowed and (isRecording and "● ĐANG THU" or "● THU ÂM") or (isRecording and "● REC" or "●")
        replayBtn.Text = labelsAllowed and "↻ PHÁT LẠI" or "↻"
        speedLabel.Visible = showUi
        speedLabel.Text = "TỐC ĐỘ"
        speedLabel.TextSize = 10
        local speedGap = speedGapWide
        local speedW = speedWWide
        local groupW = speedGroupWWide
        local speedStart = cw - groupW
        local speedControlHeight = mobileLandscape and 29 or 34
        speedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, speedStart, 0, 0)
        speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, speedControlHeight)
        for i, button in ipairs(PianoUI.speedButtons) do
            PianoUI.setButtonLayout(button, UDim2.new(0, speedStart + 54 + (i - 1) * (speedW + speedGap), 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, speedW, 0, speedControlHeight))
            button.Text = PianoUI.SPEED_LABELS[i]
            button.TextSize = 10
        end
    end
    controls.Visible = showUi
    for _, button in ipairs(PianoUI.speedButtons) do button.Visible = showUi end

    -- The tab row is a real workspace selector on touch and desktop, not just a portrait workaround.
    -- Keep the tab bar above the keybed. The previous y=139 layout placed the
    -- navigation row on top of the keyboard on landscape phones with a scaled viewport.
    local navY = compactPortrait and 128 or (mobileLandscape and 94 or 99)
    local navHeight = compactPortrait and 29 or (mobileLandscape and 25 or 27)
    PianoUI.mobileNav.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, navY)
    PianoUI.mobileNav.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, navHeight)
    PianoUI.mobileNav.Visible = showUi
    local tabs = {
        {PianoUI.mobilePlayTab, "CHƠI", "CHƠI"},
        {PianoUI.mobileSongTab, "BẢN NHẠC", compactPortrait and "NHẠC" or "BẢN NHẠC"},
        {PianoUI.mobileChordTab, "HỢP ÂM", "HỢP ÂM"},
        {PianoUI.mobileMetronomeTab, "METRONOME", compactPortrait and "NHỊP" or "METRONOME"},
        {PianoUI.mobileRecordTab, "THU ÂM", compactPortrait and "THU" or "THU ÂM"},
        {PianoUI.mobileGameTab, "LUYỆN TẬP", compactPortrait and "LUYỆN" or "LUYỆN TẬP"},
    }
    local tabGap = compactPortrait and 3 or 5
    local tabW = math.floor((cw - tabGap * (#tabs - 1)) / #tabs)
    for i, item in ipairs(tabs) do
        local button, page, label = item[1], item[2], item[3]
        local selected = (page == PianoUI.mobilePage and classic) or (page == "LUYỆN TẬP" and not classic)
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(button, UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * (tabW + tabGap), 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, tabW, 0, navHeight))
        button.Text = label
        button.TextSize = compactPortrait and 8 or (tabW < 90 and 8 or 9)
        PianoUI.setButtonBaseColor(button, selected and COLORS.accent or COLORS.panel2)
        button.TextColor3 = selected and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or COLORS.text
        button.Visible = true
    end

    -- Settings row: all controls fit in landscape; portrait filters to the current workspace tab.
    local settingsY = compactPortrait and 91 or (mobileLandscape and 61 or 64)
    instrumentControls.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, settingsY)
    instrumentControls.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, mobileLandscape and 26 or 29)
    instrumentControls.Visible = showUi
    local allSettingButtons = {sustainBtn, softBtn, dynamicsBtn, transposeDownBtn, transposeLabel, transposeUpBtn, tempoBtn, metronomeBtn, loopBtn, copyTakeBtn, PianoUI.sostenutoBtn, PianoUI.roomBtn}
    local wideSettingsLabels = {
        sustainEnabled and "GIỮ ÂM ✓" or "GIỮ ÂM",
        softEnabled and "ÊM ✓" or "ÊM",
        "LỰC " .. tostring(dynamicsIndex) .. "/4",
        "ÂM −", string.format("%+d BT", transposeSemitones), "ÂM +",
        "NHỊP " .. tostring(tempoBpm), metronomeEnabled and "GÕ BẬT" or "GÕ TẮT",
        loopPlayback and "LẶP BẬT" or "LẶP TẮT", "CHÉP BẢN",
        PianoUI.sostenutoEnabled and "SOS BẬT" or "SOS TẮT",
        PianoUI.roomEnabled and "PHÒNG BẬT" or "PHÒNG TẮT",
    }
    -- Keep the settings row calm on every screen: only show controls relevant to the active tab.
    -- This avoids a crowded 12-button strip on PCs that report TouchEnabled=false on mobile emulators.
    local settingsByPage = {
        ["CHƠI"] = {sustainBtn, softBtn, dynamicsBtn, transposeDownBtn, transposeLabel, transposeUpBtn, PianoUI.sostenutoBtn},
        ["BẢN NHẠC"] = {tempoBtn, loopBtn, copyTakeBtn, dynamicsBtn},
        ["HỢP ÂM"] = {sustainBtn, softBtn, dynamicsBtn, transposeDownBtn, transposeLabel, transposeUpBtn},
        ["METRONOME"] = {tempoBtn, metronomeBtn, loopBtn, PianoUI.roomBtn},
        ["THU ÂM"] = {copyTakeBtn, loopBtn, metronomeBtn, PianoUI.roomBtn},
    }
    local visibleButtons = settingsByPage[PianoUI.mobilePage] or settingsByPage["CHƠI"]
    for _, button in ipairs(allSettingButtons) do button.Visible = false end
    local gap = mobileLandscape and 6 or 4
    local count = #visibleButtons
    local availableItemW = math.floor((cw - gap * (count - 1)) / math.max(count, 1))
    -- Compact, centered control group: the piano should feel like an instrument
    -- console, not a screen full of stretched pill buttons.
    local itemW = mobileLandscape and math.min(104, availableItemW) or availableItemW
    local settingsGroupW = count * itemW + gap * math.max(0, count - 1)
    local settingsStart = mobileLandscape and math.max(0, math.floor((cw - settingsGroupW) * 0.5)) or 0
    local labels = {
        [sustainBtn] = sustainEnabled and "GIỮ ✓" or "GIỮ ÂM",
        [softBtn] = softEnabled and "ÊM ✓" or "ÊM",
        [dynamicsBtn] = "LỰC " .. tostring(dynamicsIndex),
        [transposeDownBtn] = "−",
        [transposeLabel] = string.format("%+d", transposeSemitones),
        [transposeUpBtn] = "+",
        [tempoBtn] = tostring(tempoBpm) .. " BPM",
        [metronomeBtn] = metronomeEnabled and "GÕ ✓" or "GÕ TẮT",
        [loopBtn] = loopPlayback and "LẶP ✓" or "LẶP TẮT",
        [copyTakeBtn] = "CHÉP",
        [PianoUI.sostenutoBtn] = PianoUI.sostenutoEnabled and "SOS ✓" or "SOS",
        [PianoUI.roomBtn] = PianoUI.roomEnabled and "PHÒNG ✓" or "PHÒNG",
    }
    for i, button in ipairs(visibleButtons) do
        PianoUI.setButtonLayout(button, UDim2.new(0, settingsStart + (i - 1) * (itemW + gap), 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, itemW, 0, mobileLandscape and 25 or 29))
        button.Text = labels[button] or button.Text
        button.TextSize = itemW < 48 and 8 or (itemW < 68 and 9 or 10)
        button.Visible = showUi
    end

    -- Sequence editor is a dedicated panel for songs and chord syntax (e.g. C4+E4+G4).
    local workspaceY = compactPortrait and 163 or (mobileLandscape and 130 or 133)
    local workspaceHeight = compactPortrait and 42 or 27
    autoPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, workspaceY)
    autoPanel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, workspaceHeight)
    sequenceLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    sequenceLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, compactPortrait and 54 or 86, 0, 19)
    sequenceLabel.TextSize = compactPortrait and 9 or 9
    sequenceClip.Position = UDim2.new(0, compactPortrait and 58 or 92, 0, 0)
    sequenceClip.Size = UDim2.new(1, compactPortrait and -58 or -92, 0, compactPortrait and 42 or 27)
    autoBox.TextSize = compactPortrait and 11 or 10
    if PianoUI.mobilePage == "HỢP ÂM" then
        sequenceLabel.Text = "HỢP ÂM"
        autoBox.PlaceholderText = "Nhập hợp âm: C4+E4+G4  •  hoặc F4+A4+C5"
    else
        sequenceLabel.Text = "BẢN NHẠC"
        autoBox.PlaceholderText = "Nhập nốt: C4 D4 E4  •  dùng dấu + để ghép hợp âm"
    end
    local sequencePage = PianoUI.mobilePage == "BẢN NHẠC" or PianoUI.mobilePage == "HỢP ÂM"
    autoPanel.Visible = showUi and sequencePage
    workspaceHintPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, workspaceY)
    workspaceHintPanel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, workspaceHeight)
    workspaceHintPanel.Visible = showUi and not sequencePage and PianoUI.mobilePage ~= "CHƠI"
    workspaceHintLabel.TextSize = compactPortrait and 9 or 9
    if PianoUI.mobilePage == "METRONOME" then
        workspaceHintLabel.Text = "CHỈNH BPM VÀ BẬT GÕ ĐỂ GIỮ NHỊP"
    elseif PianoUI.mobilePage == "THU ÂM" then
        workspaceHintLabel.Text = "BẤM THU ÂM ĐỂ GHI  •  PHÁT LẠI ĐỂ NGHE BẢN THU"
    else
        workspaceHintLabel.Text = "CHẠM PHÍM ĐỂ CHƠI  •  VUỐT NGANG ĐỂ ĐỔI QUÃNG"
    end

    -- Mini-game view retains all original game logic, while the keyboard remains docked at the bottom.
    gameControls.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, compactPortrait and 97 or 68)
    gameControls.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
    gamePanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, compactPortrait and 137 or 108)
    gamePanel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 61)
    gameControls.Visible = not classic and not hidden
    gamePanel.Visible = not classic and not hidden
    if not classic or hidden then workspaceHintPanel.Visible = false end
    hint.Visible = not hidden and not compactLandscape and not touch
    hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -15)
    hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
    hint.Text = touch and "‹  VUỐT NGANG ĐỂ CHUYỂN QUÃNG ĐÀN  ›" or "VUỐT/ CUỘN ĐỂ ĐỔI QUÃNG  •  PC: Z–M / Q–U / I–P"
    hint.TextSize = compactPortrait and 8 or 9
    hint.TextColor3 = COLORS.muted
    hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

    -- Fit the keybed into the space remaining after controls, tabs and the context
    -- strip. The old fixed 52% ratio ignored that reserved area and let the keys
    -- rise behind the tabs/hint on landscape phones.
    local contentAbsH = math.max(240, screenH - 84)
    local reservedFooter = (mobileLandscape or compactLandscape) and 17 or 22
    local clearTopY
    local needsWorkspace = PianoUI.mobilePage ~= "CHƠI"
    if hidden then
        clearTopY = 8
    elseif compactPortrait then
        clearTopY = 222 -- keep the sequence editor/game panel clear in portrait
    elseif not classic then
        clearTopY = 178 -- mini-game prompt stays above the keys
    elseif mobileLandscape and needsWorkspace then
        clearTopY = 166 -- sequence/metronome/record context panel remains unobstructed
    elseif mobileLandscape then
        clearTopY = 138 -- Play page: close the gap between tabs and keys
    elseif needsWorkspace then
        clearTopY = 174
    else
        clearTopY = 158
    end
    -- Dock the keys immediately below the active workspace. This uses the screen
    -- height instead of leaving a dead-black band between the tabs and the keybed.
    local deckRatio = hidden and (portrait and 0.48 or 0.50)
        or (portrait and 0.34 or (mobileLandscape and 0.34 or (compactLandscape and 0.36 or 0.46)))
    local desiredDeckHeight = math.floor((mobileLandscape or compactLandscape) and (screenH * deckRatio) or (contentAbsH * deckRatio))
    local maxDeckHeight = math.max(72, contentAbsH - clearTopY - reservedFooter)
    local deckHeight = math.clamp(desiredDeckHeight, math.min(72, maxDeckHeight), maxDeckHeight)
    keyboardDeck.Position = UDim2.new(0, -2, 1, -(deckHeight + reservedFooter))
    keyboardDeck.Size = UDim2.new(1, 4, 0, deckHeight + 3)
    keyboardFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -(deckHeight + reservedFooter - 1))
    keyboardFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, deckHeight)
    keyArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 4)
    keyArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -8)
    keyArea.ScrollBarThickness = touch and 4 or 3
    keyArea.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.35
    keyArea.ScrollingEnabled = true

    -- In page layouts with hidden controls, don't leave their input targets layered over the keyboard.
    classicTab.Visible = false
    gamesTab.Visible = false
    volumeLabel.Visible = not hidden
    PianoUI.volumeSliderTrack.Visible = not hidden
end

local function bindCamera(nextCamera)
    if PianoUI.cameraConnection then
        PianoUI.cameraConnection:Disconnect()
        PianoUI.cameraConnection = nil
    end
    PianoUI.camera = nextCamera
    if PianoUI.camera then
        PianoUI.cameraConnection = PianoUI.camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(PianoUI.fitToScreen)
    end
    PianoUI.fitToScreen()
end
bindCamera(workspace.CurrentCamera)
trackLifetimeConnection(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
    bindCamera(workspace.CurrentCamera)
end))

-- Lifecycle cleanup also runs when this file is executed again and replaces the GUI.
PianoUI.cleanupComplete = false
gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
    if PianoUI.cleanupComplete then return end
    PianoUI.cleanupComplete = true
    shuttingDown = true
    for _, tween in ipairs(rgbBorderTweens) do
        pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
    end
    table.clear(rgbBorderTweens)
    sequenceToken += 1
    gameToken += 1
    gameRunning = false
    gameCanInput = false
    playing = false
    paused = false
    isRecording = false
    currentPlaybackMode = nil
    if PianoUI.cameraConnection then
        PianoUI.cameraConnection:Disconnect()
        PianoUI.cameraConnection = nil
    end
    for _, connection in ipairs(lifetimeConnections) do
        pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
    end
    metronomeEnabled = false
    metronomeToken += 1
    metronomeLoopGeneration += 1
    for _, tween in ipairs(rgbBorderTweens) do pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end) end
    for _, snd in ipairs(sounds) do
        if snd and snd.Parent then
            local fade = voiceState.fadeTweens[snd]
            if fade then pcall(function() fade:Cancel() end); voiceState.fadeTweens[snd] = nil end
            pcall(function()
                snd:Stop()
                snd:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    if PianoUI.soundGroup and PianoUI.soundGroup.Parent then
        pcall(function() PianoUI.soundGroup:Destroy() end)
    end
end)


]==]

    local function findPianoGui()
        local roots = {}
        pcall(function()
            local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then table.insert(roots, pg) end
        end)
        pcall(function() table.insert(roots, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
        if type(gethui) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                local hidden = gethui()
                if hidden then table.insert(roots, hidden) end
            end)
        end
        for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
            if root then
                local g = root:FindFirstChild(PIANO_GUI_NAME)
                if g then return g end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function startPiano()
        if findPianoGui() then return true end
        if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
            return false, "Executor thiếu loadstring"
        end
        local fn, compileErr = loadstring(PIANO_SOURCE, "@Dungdx_GrandPiano")
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return false, "Compile lỗi: " .. tostring(compileErr)
        end
        local ok, runtimeErr = pcall(fn)
        if not ok then
            return false, "Runtime lỗi: " .. tostring(runtimeErr)
        end
        if not findPianoGui() then
            return false, "Không tạo được GUI piano"
        end
        return true
    end

    local function stopPiano()
        local g = findPianoGui()
        if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
        pcall(function()
            local ss = game:GetService("SoundService")
            for _, s in ipairs(ss:GetChildren()) do
                if s:IsA("Sound") and (s.Name:match("^PianoSample_%d+_%d+$")
                    or s.Name:match("^DungdxVP_PianoSample_%d+_%d+$")
                    or s.Name == "DungdxVP_MetronomeClick") then
                    pcall(function() s:Stop(); s:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
            local group = ss:FindFirstChild("DungdxGrandPianoSoundGroup")
            if group then pcall(function() group:Destroy() end) end
        end)
    end

    FeatureControl.pianoStop = stopPiano

    -- ─── UI toggle ───
    local ePiano = mSec(extendPage, "🎹 Đàn Piano ảo (Grand Piano 3D)",
        "Đàn piano 3D 75 phím A0–B6 với thu âm, hợp âm, mini-game", 17)

    local pianoStatusRow = mRow(ePiano, 1)
    pianoStatusRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
    local pianoStatusLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", pianoStatusRow)
    pianoStatusLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20)
    pianoStatusLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6)
    pianoStatusLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    pianoStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Tắt"
    pianoStatusLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    pianoStatusLbl.TextSize = 12
    pianoStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Sub
    pianoStatusLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    local pianoStatusSub = Instance.new("TextLabel", pianoStatusRow)
    pianoStatusSub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 16)
    pianoStatusSub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 28)
    pianoStatusSub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    pianoStatusSub.Text = "Nhấn nút bên dưới để mở đàn piano"
    pianoStatusSub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    pianoStatusSub.TextSize = 10
    pianoStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Sub
    pianoStatusSub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local pianoToggleRef
    pianoToggleRef = mTog(ePiano, "Bật đàn Piano",
        "Mở/đóng cửa sổ Grand Piano 3D", false, 2, function(v)
        if v then
            pianoStatusLbl.Text = "Đang tải piano..."
            pianoStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Accent
            pianoStatusSub.Text = "Vui lòng chờ..."
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, err = startPiano()
                if ok then
                    pianoStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Đang mở"
                    pianoStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Green
                    pianoStatusSub.Text = "Dùng nút × trên cửa sổ hoặc tắt toggle để đóng"
                else
                    pianoStatusLbl.Text = "Lỗi: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 90)
                    pianoStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Danger
                    pianoStatusSub.Text = "Không thể mở đàn piano"
                    pianoStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Danger
                    warn("[Dungdx Piano] " .. tostring(err))
                    task.defer(function()
                        if pianoToggleRef and pianoToggleRef.Sync then
                            pianoToggleRef:Sync(false)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        else
            stopPiano()
            pianoStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Tắt"
            pianoStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Sub
            pianoStatusSub.Text = "Nhấn nút bên dưới để mở đàn piano"
            pianoStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Sub
        end
    end)

    mBtn(ePiano, "🔄 Tải lại Piano", "Đóng và mở lại cửa sổ piano", "Reload", 3, function()
        stopPiano()
        task.wait(0.3)
        local ok, err = startPiano()
        if ok then
            pianoStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Đang mở (reload)"
            pianoStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Green
        else
            pianoStatusLbl.Text = "Lỗi reload: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 80)
            pianoStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Danger
        end
    end)
    -- ═══════════════ 🎯 AIM TRAINER — TOGGLE ĐIỀU KHIỂN TRỌN VÒNG ĐỜI ═══════════════
    -- BẬT  → compile & chạy code nhúng sẵn
    -- TẮT  → gỡ sạch: hook destroy (nếu có) + ScreenGui mới + Sound mới
    -- Script chính KHÔNG bị ảnh hưởng.

    local AIM_TRAINER_SOURCE = [==[
-- ============================================================
-- Dungdx Aim Trainer v11.1 - NEXUS ULTIMATE / INVISIBLE CORNER RESIZE & RGB FRAME
-- ============================================================

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService     = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService     = game:GetService("SoundService")
local GuiService       = game:GetService("GuiService")
local HttpService      = game:GetService("HttpService")

-- Persistent profile storage. In executor environments this uses readfile/writefile.
-- A normal Roblox LocalScript cannot write DataStores; that requires a server Script.
local PROFILE_FILE = "DungdxAimTrainer_Nexus_v11_profile.json"
local saveProfile
local function loadProfileData()
    if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local okRead, raw = pcall(readfile, PROFILE_FILE)
    if not okRead or type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 250000 then return nil end
    local okDecode, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not okDecode or type(data) ~= "table" or data.Version ~= 1 then return nil end
    return data
end
local persistedProfile = loadProfileData()
local filePersistenceAvailable = type(readfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function"
local profileSaveStatus = filePersistenceAvailable and "💾 HỒ SƠ: FILE SAVE SẴN SÀNG" or "⚠️ HỒ SƠ: KHÔNG CÓ FILE API"
local saveStatusLabel = nil

local player    = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Remove the previous UI first so its cleanup can restore the cursor before we snapshot it.
local previousGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("DungdxAimTrainer")
if previousGui then previousGui:Destroy() end
local previousMouseIconEnabled = UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled
-- The original v8.0 did not restore the cursor when its GUI was removed.
if previousGui and not previousMouseIconEnabled then previousMouseIconEnabled = true end

local connections = {}
local alive = true
local function connectTracked(signal, callback)
    local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
    table.insert(connections, connection)
    return connection
end

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
while not camera do
    task.wait()
    camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
end

local CONFIG = {
	GameTime = 30, TargetSize = 75, ComboWindow = 1.5, TargetLifetime = 3.5,
	TrapChance = 0.05, TrapMinScore = 5,
	BGMVolume = 0.2, SFXVolume = 0.6,

	BGMEnabled = true, SFXEnabled = true,
}

local C = {
    -- Deep graphite / navy surfaces with restrained technical accents.
    BgDark = Color3.fromRGB(6, 10, 18),
    PanelTop = Color3.fromRGB(11, 19, 32), PanelBot = Color3.fromRGB(7, 13, 24),
    CardTop = Color3.fromRGB(18, 31, 49), CardBot = Color3.fromRGB(11, 21, 36),
    CardHover = Color3.fromRGB(28, 48, 69),
    NeonCyan = Color3.fromRGB(66, 224, 235), NeonPink = Color3.fromRGB(235, 105, 190),
    NeonPurple = Color3.fromRGB(157, 132, 255), NeonYellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 198, 94),
    NeonOrange = Color3.fromRGB(255, 143, 92),
    TrapRed = Color3.fromRGB(239, 78, 91), TrapDark = Color3.fromRGB(111, 38, 49),
    TextWhite = Color3.fromRGB(232, 240, 248), TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(156, 173, 192),
    DangerRed = Color3.fromRGB(239, 86, 98), SuccessGreen = Color3.fromRGB(78, 218, 167),
    Dim = Color3.fromRGB(67, 84, 105),

local soundGroup = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
soundGroup.Volume = 1
soundGroup.Parent = SoundService

local function mkSound(id, vol, looped)
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	s.Volume = vol
	s.Looped = looped or false
	s.SoundGroup = soundGroup
	s.Parent = soundGroup
	return s
end

local SFX = {
	BGM = mkSound("1837879082", CONFIG.BGMVolume, true),
	Hit = mkSound("6042053623", CONFIG.SFXVolume),
	Miss = mkSound("6042053623", CONFIG.SFXVolume * 0.7),
	Countdown = mkSound("12221967", CONFIG.SFXVolume * 1.1),
	End = mkSound("138082104", CONFIG.SFXVolume * 1.3),
	Click = mkSound("6042053623", CONFIG.SFXVolume * 0.35),
	Hover = mkSound("6042053623", CONFIG.SFXVolume * 0.15),
	Achieve = mkSound("138082104", CONFIG.SFXVolume * 1.4),
	Trap = mkSound("138082104", CONFIG.SFXVolume * 1.5),
	Wrong = mkSound("6042053623", CONFIG.SFXVolume * 0.8),
}
SFX.Miss.PlaybackSpeed = 0.5
SFX.Click.PlaybackSpeed = 1.6
SFX.Hover.PlaybackSpeed = 2.0
SFX.Trap.PlaybackSpeed = 0.6
SFX.Wrong.PlaybackSpeed = 0.7

local function playSFX(name)
    if not alive then return end
    if name == "BGM" then
        if CONFIG.BGMEnabled and not SFX.BGM.IsPlaying then SFX.BGM:Play() end
        return
    end
    local sound = SFX[name]
    if CONFIG.SFXEnabled and sound then
        sound:Play()
    end
end

local function corner(p, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = typeof(r) == "number" and UDim.new(0, r) or r
	c.Parent = p
	return c
end
local function stroke(p, color, thick, trans)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color; s.Thickness = thick or 1; s.Transparency = trans or 0
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Parent = p
	return s
end
local function textStroke(label, thickness, transparency)
    -- Keep contrast, but avoid the heavy cartoon-style black outline used by the old UI.
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(3, 8, 15)
    s.Thickness = math.min(thickness or 1, 1.2)
    s.Transparency = math.max(transparency or 0.6, 0.56)
    s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
    s.Parent = label
    return s
end
local function mk(cls, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(cls)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function tween(obj, time, props, style, dir)
	local t = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(time, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	t:Play()
	return t
end
local function addButtonEffects(btn, baseColor, hoverColor, pressColor)
	local btnScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	btnScale.Scale = 1
	btnScale.Parent = btn
	local isHovering = false
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() isHovering = true; tween(btn, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = hoverColor }) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() isHovering = false; tween(btn, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = baseColor }); tween(btnScale, 0.12, { Scale = 1 }) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(btnScale, 0.08, { Scale = 0.95 }); tween(btn, 0.08, { BackgroundColor3 = pressColor }) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(btnScale, 0.15, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back); tween(btn, 0.12, { BackgroundColor3 = isHovering and hoverColor or baseColor }) end)
end

-- SCREEN GUI
local screenGui = mk("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "DungdxAimTrainer", ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
}, playerGui)
local rgbTween = nil
screenGui.Destroying:Connect(function()
    if saveProfile then pcall(saveProfile) end
    if rgbTween then pcall(function() rgbTween:Cancel() end) end
    alive = false
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        if connection.Connected then connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    if SFX.BGM then SFX.BGM:Stop() end
    if soundGroup and soundGroup.Parent then soundGroup:Destroy() end
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = previousMouseIconEnabled
end)

-- Keep the backdrop fixed to the viewport and size gameplay targets independently.
-- Main-panel geometry is recalculated later from the safe viewport area.
local targetScaleFactor = 1
local responsiveUpdate
local hudResponsiveUpdate
local function updateScale()
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        targetScaleFactor = math.clamp(vp.X / 420, 0.85, 1.15)
    else
        targetScaleFactor = vp.X < 900 and 0.95 or 1
    end
    if responsiveUpdate then responsiveUpdate() end
    if hudResponsiveUpdate then hudResponsiveUpdate() end
end
updateScale()
connectTracked(camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), updateScale)
connectTracked(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), function()
    local nextCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not nextCamera then return end
    camera = nextCamera
    connectTracked(camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), updateScale)
    updateScale()
end)

local launcherSize = 52
local launcherUserMoved = false

local function clampLauncherPosition(point, viewport)
    local maxX = math.max(8, viewport.X - launcherSize - 8)
    local maxY = math.max(8, viewport.Y - launcherSize - 8)
    local topInsetY = 0
    pcall(function()
        local topLeft = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
        topInsetY = topLeft.Y
    end)
    local minY = math.min(math.max(8, topInsetY + 4), maxY)

end
local LAUNCHER_IMAGE_ID = "91434453184512"
local function makeFloatBtn(icon, order, color, useAvatarImage)
    local className = useAvatarImage and "ImageButton" or "TextButton"
    local props = {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (order - 1) * 48),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.CardTop, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 100,
    }

        props.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. LAUNCHER_IMAGE_ID

    else
        props.Text = icon
        props.TextSize = 18
        props.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        props.TextColor3 = color
    end
    local btn = mk(className, props, toolbar)
    corner(btn, UDim.new(1, 0))
    stroke(btn, color, 1.5, 0.2)
    addButtonEffects(btn, C.CardTop, C.CardHover, C.CardBot)
    return btn
end
local floatToggle = makeFloatBtn("🎯", 1, C.NeonCyan, true)

corner(main, 14)
local mainStroke = stroke(main, C.NeonCyan, 2.2, 0.04)

		BackgroundColor3 = C.CardTop, Text = text, TextColor3 = color,

	}, navBtns)

	corner(indicator, UDim.new(1, 0))
	addButtonEffects(b, C.CardTop, C.CardHover, C.CardBot)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if activePageName == pageKey then
            tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundColor3 = color })
        end
    end)
	navBtnList[pageKey] = { btn = b, indicator = indicator, color = color, stroke = navStroke }
	return b
end

responsiveUpdate = function()
    if not main or not main.Parent then return end
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    local topInset, bottomInset = Vector2.zero, Vector2.zero
    pcall(function()
        topInset, bottomInset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
    end)

    local safeWidth = math.max(1, vp.X - math.max(0, topInset.X) - math.max(0, bottomInset.X))
    -- Reserve space for Roblox's top controls as well as the physical safe area.
    local safeTop = math.min(vp.Y * 0.16, math.max(topInset.Y + 56, 56))
    local safeBottom = vp.Y - math.max(0, bottomInset.Y) - 12
    if safeBottom < safeTop + 160 then
        safeTop = math.max(8, vp.Y * 0.10)
        safeBottom = math.min(vp.Y - 2, math.max(safeTop + 160, vp.Y - 8))
        safeTop = math.min(safeTop, math.max(6, safeBottom - 160))
    end
    local usableHeight = math.max(1, safeBottom - safeTop)
    local maxPanelWidth = math.max(220, math.min(1160, safeWidth - 12))
    local minPanelWidth = math.min(300, maxPanelWidth)
    local maxPanelHeight = math.max(1, math.min(720, usableHeight - 4))
    local minPanelHeight = math.min(220, maxPanelHeight)
    local panelWidth
    local panelHeight
    if panelCustomSize then
        panelWidth = math.clamp(panelCustomSize.X, minPanelWidth, maxPanelWidth)
        panelHeight = math.clamp(panelCustomSize.Y, minPanelHeight, maxPanelHeight)
        panelCustomSize = Vector2.new(panelWidth, panelHeight)
    else
        panelWidth = math.min(1160, math.max(1, safeWidth - math.min(24, safeWidth * 0.08)))
        panelHeight = math.min(usableHeight, math.max(math.min(200, usableHeight), math.min(720, usableHeight - 8)))
    end

    main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(panelWidth, panelHeight)
    local defaultTopLeft = Vector2.new((vp.X - panelWidth) * 0.5, safeTop + (usableHeight - panelHeight) * 0.5)
    local topLeft = defaultTopLeft
    if panelPositionLocked and panelPosition then
        local minX = 4
        local maxX = math.max(minX, vp.X - panelWidth - 4)
        local minY = math.min(math.max(4, topInset.Y + 4), math.max(4, vp.Y - panelHeight - 4))
        local maxY = math.max(minY, vp.Y - math.max(0, bottomInset.Y) - panelHeight - 4)
        topLeft = Vector2.new(math.clamp(panelPosition.X, minX, maxX), math.clamp(panelPosition.Y, minY, maxY))
        panelPosition = topLeft
    end
    main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(topLeft.X + panelWidth * 0.5, topLeft.Y + panelHeight * 0.5)

    local showBrand = panelWidth >= 760
    local showCompactBrand = panelWidth >= 330 and not showBrand
    local showAudio = panelWidth >= 430
    local navStart = showBrand and 164 or (showCompactBrand and 88 or 8)
    local navReserved = showAudio and 124 or 16
    logoFrame.Visible = showBrand or showCompactBrand
    if showBrand then
        dragGrip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        dragGrip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(156, 50)
    elseif showCompactBrand then
        dragGrip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        dragGrip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(86, 50)
    else
        -- On very narrow screens keep a slim, non-intrusive drag strip above the tabs.
        dragGrip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        dragGrip.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 7)
    end
    minimizeBtn.Visible = showAudio
    floatBGM.Visible = showAudio
    floatSFX.Visible = showAudio

    if showBrand then
        logoFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
        logoFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 1, 0)
        logoText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 4)
        logoText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 23)
        logoText.TextSize = 17
        logoText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        logoSub.Visible = true
    elseif showCompactBrand then
        logoFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
        logoFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 1, 0)
        logoText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(19, 0)
        logoText.Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 1, 0)
        logoText.TextSize = 11
        logoText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        logoSub.Visible = false
    end

    navBtns.Position = UDim2.new(0, navStart, 0, 0)
    navBtns.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(navStart + navReserved), 1, 0)
    local approximateTabWidth = (panelWidth - navStart - navReserved) / 4
    local tabTextSize = approximateTabWidth < 58 and 10 or (approximateTabWidth < 94 and 8 or 10)
    local navLabels = approximateTabWidth < 58 and {
        Play = "🎮", Stats = "📊", Achievements = "🏆", Settings = "⚙️",
    } or (approximateTabWidth < 94 and {
        Play = "🎮 CHƠI", Stats = "📊 SỐ", Achievements = "🏆 ĐẠT", Settings = "⚙️ SET",
    } or {
        Play = "🎮 CHƠI", Stats = "📊 THỐNG KÊ", Achievements = "🏆 THÀNH TỰU", Settings = "⚙️ CÀI ĐẶT",
    })
    for key, data in pairs(navBtnList) do
        data.btn.TextSize = tabTextSize
        data.btn.Text = navLabels[key] or key
    end

    if showAudio then
        minimizeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0.5, -14)
        floatBGM.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 30)
        floatBGM.Position = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0.5, -15)
        floatSFX.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 30)
        floatSFX.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0.5, -15)
    end

    toolbar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(launcherSize, launcherSize)
    floatToggle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
    floatToggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
    floatToggle.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. LAUNCHER_IMAGE_ID
    floatToggle.ImageTransparency = 0
    floatToggle.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    if launcherUserMoved and launcherPosition then
        launcherPosition = clampLauncherPosition(launcherPosition, vp)
    else
        launcherPosition = clampLauncherPosition(Vector2.new(vp.X - launcherSize - 12, safeTop + 8), vp)
    end
    toolbar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(launcherPosition.X, launcherPosition.Y)

    if hudResponsiveUpdate then hudResponsiveUpdate() end
end
responsiveUpdate()
connectTracked(main:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
    if main.Parent then responsiveUpdate() end
end)

local function pointerIn(guiObject, point)
    if not guiObject or not guiObject.Parent or not guiObject.Visible then return false end
    local pos, size = guiObject.AbsolutePosition, guiObject.AbsoluteSize
    return point.X >= pos.X and point.X <= pos.X + size.X and point.Y >= pos.Y and point.Y <= pos.Y + size.Y
end

local function beginPanelDrag(input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    if not main.Visible then return end
    local point = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    -- On narrow layouts the 7px strip remains draggable even above the tab container.
    local onSlimTopGrip = dragGrip.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 8 and point.Y <= dragGrip.AbsolutePosition.Y + dragGrip.AbsoluteSize.Y
    -- Do not turn navigation/audio clicks into drags.
    if (pointerIn(navBtns, point) and not onSlimTopGrip) or pointerIn(minimizeBtn, point) or pointerIn(floatBGM, point) or pointerIn(floatSFX, point) then return end
    panelPosition = Vector2.new(main.AbsolutePosition.X, main.AbsolutePosition.Y)
    panelPositionLocked = true
    panelDragState = {
        input = input,
        inputType = input.UserInputType,
        pointer = point,
        origin = panelPosition,
    }
end

navBar.InputBegan:Connect(beginPanelDrag)
logoFrame.InputBegan:Connect(beginPanelDrag)
dragGrip.InputBegan:Connect(beginPanelDrag)

for grip, directions in pairs(resizeHandles) do
    grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if not main.Visible then return end
        panelPosition = Vector2.new(main.AbsolutePosition.X, main.AbsolutePosition.Y)
        panelPositionLocked = true
        panelResizeState = {
            input = input,
            inputType = input.UserInputType,
            pointer = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y),
            size = Vector2.new(main.AbsoluteSize.X, main.AbsoluteSize.Y),
            origin = panelPosition,
            sx = directions.sx,
            sy = directions.sy,
        }
    end)
end

connectTracked(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
    if panelDragState then
        local isMouseMove = panelDragState.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        local isTouchMove = panelDragState.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        if isMouseMove or isTouchMove then
            local pointer = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
            local delta = pointer - panelDragState.pointer
            panelPosition = Vector2.new(panelDragState.origin.X + delta.X, panelDragState.origin.Y + delta.Y)
            panelPositionLocked = true
            responsiveUpdate()
        end
    elseif panelResizeState then
        local isMouseMove = panelResizeState.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        local isTouchMove = panelResizeState.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        if isMouseMove or isTouchMove then
            local pointer = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
            local delta = pointer - panelResizeState.pointer
            local startSize = panelResizeState.size
            local origin = panelResizeState.origin
            local sx, sy = panelResizeState.sx, panelResizeState.sy

            -- First apply and clamp the new size. Then offset the top-left for left/top
            -- grips so the opposite corner stays anchored while resizing.
            panelPosition = origin
            panelPositionLocked = true
            panelCustomSize = Vector2.new(startSize.X + delta.X * sx, startSize.Y + delta.Y * sy)
            responsiveUpdate()

            local actualSize = panelCustomSize or startSize
            panelPosition = Vector2.new(
                origin.X + (sx < 0 and (startSize.X - actualSize.X) or 0),
                origin.Y + (sy < 0 and (startSize.Y - actualSize.Y) or 0)
            )
            responsiveUpdate()
        end
    end
end)

connectTracked(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
    if panelDragState then
        local released = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input == panelDragState.input
            or (panelDragState.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
        if released then panelDragState = nil end
    end
    if panelResizeState then
        local released = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input == panelResizeState.input
            or (panelResizeState.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
        if released then panelResizeState = nil end
    end
end)

local pages = {}
local function newPage(name)
    local isScrollablePage = name == "Play" or name == "Stats"
    local className = isScrollablePage and "ScrollingFrame" or "Frame"
    local props = {
        Name = name, Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -66),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Visible = false, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 3,
    }
    if isScrollablePage then
        props.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 560)
        props.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
        props.ScrollBarThickness = 3
        props.ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.NeonCyan
        props.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.35
        props.BorderSizePixel = 0
        props.BackgroundColor3 = C.PanelTop
    end
    local f = mk(className, props, main)
    pages[name] = f
    return f
end
local function showPage(name)
    activePageName = name
	for n, p in pairs(pages) do p.Visible = (n == name) end
	for key, data in pairs(navBtnList) do
		if key == name then
			data.btn.TextColor3 = C.TextWhite
			tween(data.btn, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = data.color })
			tween(data.indicator, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
		else
			data.btn.TextColor3 = C.TextDim
			tween(data.btn, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = C.CardTop })
			tween(data.indicator, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		end
	end
end

    cardGradient.Rotation = 90
    cardGradient.Parent = card
    local accent = mk("Frame", {

        TextTransparency = 0.42, TextSize = 34, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,

    }, card)
    local nm = mk("TextLabel", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = info.name, TextColor3 = info.color,

        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 40),
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, Text = info.desc, TextColor3 = C.TextDim,
        TextSize = 10, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 5,
    }, card)
    local start = mk("TextLabel", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -25),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Text = "▶  BẮT ĐẦU", TextColor3 = C.NeonCyan,
        TextSize = 9, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 5,
    }, card)
    card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(card, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = C.CardHover })
        tween(cardStroke, 0.15, { Transparency = 0.15 })
    end)
    card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(card, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = C.CardTop })
        tween(cardStroke, 0.15, { Transparency = 0.48 })
    end)
    local cardScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    cardScale.Scale = 1
    cardScale.Parent = card
    card.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(cardScale, 0.08, { Scale = 0.985 }) end)
    card.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(cardScale, 0.12, { Scale = 1 }) end)
    modeCards[info.id] = card
    modeCardUI[info.id] = { icon = iconLabel, title = nm, desc = desc, start = start }
end
for _, info in ipairs(modeInfo) do makeModeCard(info) end

local function layoutPlayPage()
    if not pagePlay or not pagePlay.Parent then return end
    local size = pagePlay.AbsoluteSize
    local width, height = size.X, size.Y
    if width < 1 or height < 1 then return end
    local compact = width < 560
    local pad = width < 360 and 8 or 12
    local gap = 10
    local cardHeight
    local cardWidth
    local contentBottom
    local cardsTop = 54
    if compact then
        cardWidth = math.max(180, width - pad * 2 - 8)
        cardHeight = math.clamp(math.floor((height - cardsTop - 18) / 4 - 7), 88, 112)
        for index, info in ipairs(modeInfo) do
            local card = modeCards[info.id]
            card.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pad, cardsTop + (index - 1) * (cardHeight + gap))
            card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cardWidth, cardHeight)
            modeCardUI[info.id].icon.TextSize = 26
            modeCardUI[info.id].icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38)
            modeCardUI[info.id].icon.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 7)
            modeCardUI[info.id].title.TextSize = 13
            modeCardUI[info.id].desc.TextSize = 9
            modeCardUI[info.id].desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 30)
            modeCardUI[info.id].desc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 35)
            modeCardUI[info.id].start.TextSize = 8
            modeCardUI[info.id].start.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -21)
        end
        contentBottom = cardsTop + #modeInfo * cardHeight + (#modeInfo - 1) * gap + 10
    else
        local innerWidth = math.max(320, width - pad * 2)
        cardWidth = math.floor((innerWidth - gap) / 2)
        cardHeight = math.clamp(math.floor((height - cardsTop - 24) / 2 - 8), 112, 158)
        for index, info in ipairs(modeInfo) do
            local col = (index - 1) % 2
            local row = math.floor((index - 1) / 2)
            local card = modeCards[info.id]
            card.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pad + col * (cardWidth + gap), cardsTop + row * (cardHeight + gap))
            card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cardWidth, cardHeight)
            modeCardUI[info.id].icon.TextSize = 34
            modeCardUI[info.id].icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
            modeCardUI[info.id].icon.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 10)
            modeCardUI[info.id].title.TextSize = 15
            modeCardUI[info.id].desc.TextSize = 10
            modeCardUI[info.id].desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38)
            modeCardUI[info.id].desc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 40)
            modeCardUI[info.id].start.TextSize = 9
            modeCardUI[info.id].start.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -25)
        end
        contentBottom = cardsTop + 2 * cardHeight + gap + 10
    end
    pagePlay.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, math.max(height, contentBottom))
end
connectTracked(pagePlay:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), layoutPlayPage)
task.defer(layoutPlayPage)

local function safeProfileNumber(value, fallback)
    local n = tonumber(value)
    if not n or n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge then return fallback or 0 end
    return math.max(0, n)
end
local savedCareer = type(persistedProfile) == "table" and type(persistedProfile.Career) == "table" and persistedProfile.Career or {}
local career = {
    Games = math.floor(safeProfileNumber(savedCareer.Games, 0)),
    BestScore = math.floor(safeProfileNumber(savedCareer.BestScore, 0)),
    BestCombo = math.floor(safeProfileNumber(savedCareer.BestCombo, 0)),
    TotalHits = math.floor(safeProfileNumber(savedCareer.TotalHits, 0)),
    TotalAttempts = math.floor(safeProfileNumber(savedCareer.TotalAttempts, 0)),
    TotalRT = safeProfileNumber(savedCareer.TotalRT, 0),
    TotalRTHits = math.floor(safeProfileNumber(savedCareer.TotalRTHits, 0)),
    CleanRuns = math.floor(safeProfileNumber(savedCareer.CleanRuns, 0)),
    AccuracyBestByAttempts = {},
    ReactionBestBySamples = {},
}
for _, attempts in ipairs({10, 25, 50, 100}) do
    local source = type(savedCareer.AccuracyBestByAttempts) == "table" and savedCareer.AccuracyBestByAttempts or {}
    career.AccuracyBestByAttempts[tostring(attempts)] = math.min(100, safeProfileNumber(source[tostring(attempts)], 0))
end
for _, samples in ipairs({5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 150}) do
    local source = type(savedCareer.ReactionBestBySamples) == "table" and savedCareer.ReactionBestBySamples or {}
    career.ReactionBestBySamples[tostring(samples)] = safeProfileNumber(source[tostring(samples)], 0)
end

local achievementState = {}
local savedAchievements = type(persistedProfile) == "table" and type(persistedProfile.Achievements) == "table" and persistedProfile.Achievements or {}
for _, a in ipairs(ACHIEVEMENTS) do
    local old = type(savedAchievements[a.id]) == "table" and savedAchievements[a.id] or {}
    achievementState[a.id] = {
        unlocked = old.unlocked == true,
        progress = safeProfileNumber(old.progress, 0),
    }
end

saveProfile = function()
    if not filePersistenceAvailable then
        profileSaveStatus = "⚠️ KHÔNG LƯU ĐƯỢC: executor thiếu readfile/writefile"
        if saveStatusLabel and saveStatusLabel.Parent then
            saveStatusLabel.Text = profileSaveStatus
            saveStatusLabel.TextColor3 = C.NeonYellow
        end
        return false
    end
    local payload = {
        Version = 1,
        SavedAt = os.time(),
        Career = career,
        Achievements = achievementState,
    }
    local okEncode, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(payload) end)
    if not okEncode then
        profileSaveStatus = "⚠️ LƯU LỖI: không mã hóa được hồ sơ"
        if saveStatusLabel and saveStatusLabel.Parent then
            saveStatusLabel.Text = profileSaveStatus
            saveStatusLabel.TextColor3 = C.DangerRed
        end
        return false
    end
    local okWrite = pcall(writefile, PROFILE_FILE, encoded)
    profileSaveStatus = okWrite and "💾 ĐÃ LƯU HỒ SƠ VÀO FILE" or "⚠️ LƯU LỖI: writefile bị từ chối"
    if saveStatusLabel and saveStatusLabel.Parent then
        saveStatusLabel.Text = profileSaveStatus
        saveStatusLabel.TextColor3 = okWrite and C.SuccessGreen or C.DangerRed
    end
    return okWrite
end

local achievementRows = {}

local function refreshAchievements()
	for _, row in pairs(achievementRows) do row:Destroy() end
	achievementRows = {}
	for i, a in ipairs(ACHIEVEMENTS) do
		local st = achievementState[a.id]
		local unlocked = st.unlocked
		local row = mk("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
			BackgroundColor3 = unlocked and Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 55) or C.CardTop,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 5,
		}, achieveScroll)
		corner(row, 8)
		stroke(row, unlocked and C.SuccessGreen or C.Dim, 1.5, unlocked and 0.2 or 0.5)
		mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -20), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = a.icon, TextColor3 = unlocked and C.SuccessGreen or C.TextDim, TextSize = 22, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
		local nm = mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 8), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = a.name, TextColor3 = unlocked and C.SuccessGreen or C.TextWhite, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
		textStroke(nm, 1, 0.5)
		local desc = mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 26), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = string.format("TIER %02d  •  %s", a.tier or 1, a.desc), TextColor3 = C.TextDim, TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
		textStroke(desc, 1, 0.6)
        local progressText = "✅ XONG"
        if not unlocked then
            if a.metric == "reaction" then
                local best = career.ReactionBestBySamples[tostring(a.minSamples)] or 0
                progressText = best > 0 and string.format("%dms / ≤%d", math.floor(best + 0.5), a.target) or ("0/" .. a.minSamples .. " hits")
            elseif a.metric == "accuracy" then
                local best = career.AccuracyBestByAttempts[tostring(a.minAttempts)] or 0
                progressText = string.format("%d/%d%%", math.min(math.floor(best), a.target), a.target)
            elseif a.metric == "combo" then
                progressText = string.format("x%d/x%d", math.min(career.BestCombo, a.target), a.target)
            else
                local val = a.metric == "games" and career.Games or (a.metric == "score" and career.BestScore or career.CleanRuns)
                progressText = string.format("%d/%d", math.min(math.floor(val), a.target), a.target)
            end
        end
		local progressLbl = mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 124, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0.5, -12), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = progressText, TextColor3 = unlocked and C.SuccessGreen or C.NeonYellow, TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
		textStroke(progressLbl, 1, 0.4)
		table.insert(achievementRows, row)
	end
end

local function makeSlider(label, min, max, default, formatter, onChange, step)
    step = step or 1
	local row = mk("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44), BackgroundColor3 = C.CardTop, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5 }, settingsScroll)
	corner(row, 8)
	stroke(row, C.Dim, 1, 0.5)
	local lbl = mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 2), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = label, TextColor3 = C.TextWhite, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
	textStroke(lbl, 1, 0.5)
	local valLbl = mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.4, -12, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 2), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = formatter(default), TextColor3 = C.NeonCyan, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
	textStroke(valLbl, 1, 0.4)
	local barBg = mk("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 36, 55), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6, Active = true }, row)
	corner(barBg, UDim.new(1, 0))
	local barFill = mk("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C.NeonCyan, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 7 }, barBg)
	corner(barFill, UDim.new(1, 0))
	local knob = mk("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12), Position = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), -6, 0.5, -6), BackgroundColor3 = C.TextWhite, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8 }, barBg)
	corner(knob, UDim.new(1, 0))
	stroke(knob, C.NeonCyan, 1.5, 0.3)
	local dragging = false
    local function setValue(alpha)
        alpha = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
        local rawValue = min + (max - min) * alpha
        local v = min + math.floor((rawValue - min) / step + 0.5) * step
        v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
        local snappedAlpha = (v - min) / (max - min)
        barFill.Size = UDim2.new(snappedAlpha, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(snappedAlpha, -6, 0.5, -6)
        valLbl.Text = formatter(v)
        onChange(v)
    end
	local function handleInput(input)
		local abs = barBg.AbsolutePosition.X
		local w = barBg.AbsoluteSize.X
		if w > 0 then setValue((input.Position.X - abs) / w) end
	end
	barBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true; handleInput(input)
		end
	end)
	barBg.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
	end)
    connectTracked(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    connectTracked(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            handleInput(input)
        end
    end)
end

local toggleSetters = {}
local function makeToggle(label, default, onChange, syncKey)
    local row = mk("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38), BackgroundColor3 = C.CardTop, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5 }, settingsScroll)
    corner(row, 8)
    stroke(row, C.Dim, 1, 0.5)
    mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Text = label, TextColor3 = C.TextWhite, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
    local state = default
    local btn = mk("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, -11), BackgroundColor3 = state and C.SuccessGreen or C.Dim, Text = state and "ON" or "OFF", TextColor3 = C.TextWhite, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
    corner(btn, UDim.new(1, 0))

    local function applyState(nextState, playClick)
        state = not not nextState
        tween(btn, 0.12, { BackgroundColor3 = state and C.SuccessGreen or C.Dim })
        btn.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"
        if playClick then playSFX("Click") end
        if onChange then onChange(state) end
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() applyState(not state, true) end)
    if syncKey then toggleSetters[syncKey] = function(value) applyState(value, false) end end

    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Parent = btn
    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(scale, 0.08, { Scale = 0.94 }) end)
    btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(scale, 0.12, { Scale = 1 }) end)
    return btn
end

hudResponsiveUpdate = function()
    local hudWidth = hud.AbsoluteSize.X
    if hudWidth < 1 then hudWidth = main.AbsoluteSize.X end
    local compactHud = hudWidth < 700
    local startX = compactHud and 6 or 14
    -- Reserve room for pause/exit controls on narrow phone screens.
    local width = compactHud and math.clamp(math.floor((hudWidth - 112) / 4.2), 44, 78) or 110
    local gap = width + (compactHud and 4 or 5)
    local statLabels = { hudScore, hudAcc, hudCombo, hudTime }
    for index, label in ipairs(statLabels) do
        label.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
        label.Position = UDim2.new(0, startX + (index - 1) * gap, 0, 0)
        label.TextSize = compactHud and (width < 58 and 8 or 9) or 12
    end
    hudModeLbl.Visible = hudWidth >= 680
end
