local shakeConnection
local shakeElapsed = 0
local shakeIntensity = 0
local shakeOrigin
local function screenShake(intensity)
    if not CONFIG.ScreenShake or not alive or not main.Parent then return end
    shakeIntensity = math.max(shakeIntensity, intensity)
    shakeElapsed = 0
    if shakeConnection and shakeConnection.Connected then return end

    shakeOrigin = main.Position
    shakeConnection = connectTracked(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
        if not alive or not main.Parent then
            if shakeConnection then shakeConnection:Disconnect() end
            shakeConnection = nil
            return
        end
        shakeElapsed += dt
        if shakeElapsed >= 0.15 then
            main.Position = shakeOrigin
            if shakeConnection then shakeConnection:Disconnect() end
            shakeConnection = nil
            shakeIntensity = 0
            return
        end
        main.Position = shakeOrigin + UDim2.new(0, math.random(-shakeIntensity, shakeIntensity), 0, math.random(-shakeIntensity, shakeIntensity))
    end)
end

-- STATE
local state = {
	Score = 0, Combo = 0, BestCombo = 0, TimeLeft = 30, Playing = false,
	Paused = false, PausedAt = 0,
	Hits = 0, Misses = 0, LastHitTime = 0,
	ReactionSum = 0, ReactionCount = 0, ReactionList = {},
    Mode = "Gridshot", TrapsSpawned = 0, TrapsHit = 0,
    TargetNumber = nil, RoundId = 0, Finishing = false, EndTime = 0,
}
local session = {
    Games = 0, Best = 0, TotalHits = 0, TotalMisses = 0,
    TotalRT = 0, TotalRTHits = 0, Leaderboard = {}, ModesPlayed = {}, Survived = 0,
}
local finishGame
local lastTargetActivation = 0

-- SPAWN
local function getArenaSize()
    local size = arena.AbsoluteSize
    if size.X < 10 or size.Y < 10 then
        return Vector2.new(math.max(size.X, 100), math.max(size.Y, 100))
    end
    return size
end
local function isOverlapping(x, y, ignore, radius)
	for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
		if t ~= ignore and t.Visible and t:GetAttribute("PosX") then
			local ox = t:GetAttribute("PosX")
			local oy = t:GetAttribute("PosY")
			local otherR = t.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
			if math.sqrt((x - ox)^2 + (y - oy)^2) < radius + otherR + 20 then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function findFreePosition(ignore, size)
	local as = getArenaSize()
	local r = size / 2
	local pad = math.max(45, r + 8)
    local minX, maxX = pad, as.X - pad
    local topReserve = state.Mode == "Numbers" and 62 or 8
    local minY, maxY = math.max(pad, topReserve + r + 4), as.Y - pad
	if maxX <= minX or maxY <= minY then return as.X / 2, as.Y / 2 end
	for _ = 1, 30 do
		local x = math.random(math.floor(minX), math.floor(maxX))
		local y = math.random(math.floor(minY), math.floor(maxY))
		if not isOverlapping(x, y, ignore, r) then return x, y end
	end
	return math.random(math.floor(minX), math.floor(maxX)), math.random(math.floor(minY), math.floor(maxY))
end

local function respawnTarget(target, sizeOverride, forceTrap)
	local size = (sizeOverride or CONFIG.TargetSize) * targetScaleFactor
	local x, y = findFreePosition(target, size)
	target:SetAttribute("PosX", x)
	target:SetAttribute("PosY", y)
	target:SetAttribute("SpawnTime", os.clock())

    target:SetAttribute("Number", nil)
    target.NumberLabel.Text = ""
    local canTrap = state.Score >= CONFIG.TrapMinScore
    local isTrap = forceTrap
	if isTrap == nil then
		isTrap = canTrap and (math.random() < CONFIG.TrapChance)
	end
	target:SetAttribute("IsTrap", isTrap)

	if isTrap then
		state.TrapsSpawned += 1
		target.OuterRing.UIStroke.Color = C.TrapRed
		target.InnerRing.UIStroke.Color = C.TrapDark
		target.Core.BackgroundColor3 = C.TrapRed
		target.TrapIcon.Visible = true
		target.TrapIcon.TextTransparency = 0
		target.NumberLabel.Visible = false
		target.LifeRing.UIStroke.Color = C.TrapRed
	else
		local col = PALETTE[math.random(1, #PALETTE)]
		target.OuterRing.UIStroke.Color = col
		target.InnerRing.UIStroke.Color = col
		target.Core.BackgroundColor3 = col
		target.TrapIcon.Visible = false
		target.TrapIcon.TextTransparency = 1
		if state.Mode == "Numbers" then
			target.NumberLabel.Visible = true
		else
			target.NumberLabel.Visible = false
		end
		target.LifeRing.UIStroke.Color = C.NeonYellow
	end

	target.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
	target.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	target.Visible = true
	target.LifeRing.UIStroke.Transparency = 0.2
	target.LifeRing.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.3, 1.3)
	tween(target, 0.22, { Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
end

-- NUMBER MODE: only choose from visible, non-trap targets so the prompt is always achievable.
local function newNumberRound()
    local activeTargets = {}
    for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
        if target.Visible and not target:GetAttribute("IsTrap") then
            table.insert(activeTargets, target)
        end
    end

    if #activeTargets == 0 then
        local rescueTarget = targets[1]
        respawnTarget(rescueTarget, CONFIG.TargetSize * 0.9, false)
        activeTargets[1] = rescueTarget
    end

    local used = {}
    for _, target in ipairs(activeTargets) do
        local number
        repeat number = math.random(1, 99) until not used[number]
        used[number] = true
        target.NumberLabel.Text = tostring(number)
        target.NumberLabel.Visible = true
        target:SetAttribute("Number", number)
    end

    local chosen = activeTargets[math.random(1, #activeTargets)]
    state.TargetNumber = chosen:GetAttribute("Number")
    promptLabel.Text = "TÌM SỐ  /  " .. tostring(state.TargetNumber)
end

-- MODES
local modeRuntime = { velocities = {} }
local function clearAllTargets()
	for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
		t.Visible = false
		t:SetAttribute("PosX", nil); t:SetAttribute("PosY", nil)
		t:SetAttribute("SpawnTime", nil); t:SetAttribute("IsTrap", nil)
		t:SetAttribute("Number", nil)
		t.NumberLabel.Visible = false
	end
	promptLabel.Visible = false
	modeRuntime.velocities = {}
end

local function setupMode(mode)
	clearAllTargets()
	state.Mode = mode
	hudModeLbl.Text = string.upper(mode)

	if mode == "Gridshot" then
		for i = 1, 3 do respawnTarget(targets[i]) end
	elseif mode == "Flick" then
		respawnTarget(targets[1], CONFIG.TargetSize * 0.95)
	elseif mode == "Tracking" then
		local t = targets[1]
		respawnTarget(t, CONFIG.TargetSize * 0.9)
		modeRuntime.velocities[t] = { vx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 260, vy = (math.random() - 0.5) * 260 }
    elseif mode == "Numbers" then
        promptLabel.Visible = true
        for i = 1, 4 do respawnTarget(targets[i], CONFIG.TargetSize * 0.9) end
        newNumberRound()
	end
end

local function updateHUD()
	hudScore.Text = "🏆 " .. state.Score
	local total = state.Hits + state.Misses
	local acc = total > 0 and (state.Hits / total * 100) or 0
	hudAcc.Text = string.format("🎯 %.0f%%", acc)
	hudCombo.Text = "🔥 x" .. state.Combo
	hudCombo.TextColor3 = state.Combo >= 5 and C.NeonPurple or C.NeonPink
	hudTime.Text = "⏱️ " .. state.TimeLeft
	hudTime.TextColor3 = state.TimeLeft <= 5 and C.DangerRed or C.NeonCyan
end

-- ACHIEVEMENTS unlock
local function unlockAchievement(id)
	local a
	for _, x in ipairs(ACHIEVEMENTS) do if x.id == id then a = x break end end
	if not a or achievementState[id].unlocked then return end
	achievementState[id].unlocked = true
	playSFX("Achieve")
    local popupWidth = math.max(180, math.min(280, camera.ViewportSize.X - 20))
    local topInset = Vector2.zero
    pcall(function() topInset = select(1, GuiService:GetGuiInset()) end)
    local popupY = math.max(14, topInset.Y + 12)
    local popup = mk("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(popupWidth, 54), Position = UDim2.new(1, 20, 0, popupY),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.CardTop, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 300,
    }, screenGui)
    corner(popup, 10)
    stroke(popup, C.SuccessGreen, 1.5, 0.2)
    mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = "THÀNH TỰU MỚI", TextColor3 = C.SuccessGreen, TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 301 }, popup)
    mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 24), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Text = a.icon .. "  " .. a.name, TextColor3 = C.TextWhite, TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 301 }, popup)
    tween(popup, 0.4, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -popupWidth - 10, 0, popupY) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    task.delay(3.5, function()
        if not alive or not popup.Parent then return end
        tween(popup, 0.4, { Position = UDim2.new(1, 20, 0, popupY) })
        task.delay(0.5, function()
            if popup.Parent then popup:Destroy() end
        end)
    end)
	-- Progress rows are refreshed once after all values have been updated.
end

local function achievementMetric(a)
    if a.metric == "games" then return career.Games end
    if a.metric == "score" then return career.BestScore end
    if a.metric == "combo" then return career.BestCombo end
    if a.metric == "clean" then return career.CleanRuns end
    if a.metric == "accuracy" then
        return career.AccuracyBestByAttempts[tostring(a.minAttempts)] or 0
    end
    if a.metric == "reaction" then
        return career.ReactionBestBySamples[tostring(a.minSamples)] or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function achievementIsComplete(a, value)
    if a.metric == "reaction" then return value > 0 and value <= a.target end
    return value >= a.target
end

local function checkAchievements()
    for _, a in ipairs(ACHIEVEMENTS) do
        local value = achievementMetric(a)
        local st = achievementState[a.id]
        if a.metric == "reaction" then
            st.progress = value > 0 and math.max(0, a.target - math.floor(value)) or 0
        else
            st.progress = math.min(math.floor(value), a.target)
        end
        if not st.unlocked and achievementIsComplete(a, value) then
            unlockAchievement(a.id)
        end
    end
    refreshAchievements()
    saveProfile()
end

-- GAME FLOW
local function startGame(mode, roundId)
    state.Score = 0; state.Combo = 0; state.BestCombo = 0
    state.TimeLeft = CONFIG.GameTime; state.Playing = false; state.Finishing = false
    state.Paused = false; state.PausedAt = 0
    lastTargetActivation = 0
    pauseBtn.Text = "Ⅱ"
    state.EndTime = 0
    state.Hits = 0; state.Misses = 0
    state.ReactionSum = 0; state.ReactionCount = 0; state.ReactionList = {}
    state.TrapsSpawned = 0; state.TrapsHit = 0; state.TargetNumber = nil
    state.Mode = mode
    updateHUD()
    centerMsg.Visible = true

    for i = 1, 3 do
        if not alive or roundId ~= state.RoundId then return end
        centerMsg.Text = tostring(4 - i)
        centerMsg.TextColor3 = C.NeonCyan
        centerMsg.TextSize = 36
        centerMsg.TextTransparency = 0
        playSFX("Countdown")
        tween(centerMsg, 0.4, { TextSize = 70, TextTransparency = 1 })
        task.wait(0.55)
    end
    if not alive or roundId ~= state.RoundId then return end
    centerMsg.Text = "GO!"
    centerMsg.TextColor3 = C.NeonPink
    centerMsg.TextSize = 36
    centerMsg.TextTransparency = 0
    tween(centerMsg, 0.45, { TextSize = 90, TextTransparency = 1 })
    task.wait(0.3)
    if not alive or roundId ~= state.RoundId then return end
    centerMsg.Visible = false
    state.EndTime = os.clock() + CONFIG.GameTime
    state.TimeLeft = CONFIG.GameTime
    state.Playing = true
    state.LastHitTime = os.clock()
    updateHUD()
    setupMode(mode)
end

local function enterGame(mode)
    if not alive then return end
    state.RoundId += 1
    local roundId = state.RoundId
    session.ModesPlayed[mode] = true
    for _, page in pairs(pages) do page.Visible = false end
    hud.Visible = true
    navBar.Visible = false
    floatToggle.Visible = false
    startGame(mode, roundId)
end

local function exitGame()
    state.RoundId += 1 -- invalidates in-flight countdowns and delayed end screens
    state.Playing = false
    state.Paused = false
    state.PausedAt = 0
    pauseBtn.Text = "Ⅱ"
    state.Finishing = false
    centerMsg.Visible = false
    clearAllTargets()
    hud.Visible = false
    navBar.Visible = true
    main.Visible = true
    background.Visible = true
    floatToggle.Visible = false
    showPage("Play")
end

local function togglePause()
    if not state.Playing or state.Finishing then return end
    if not state.Paused then
        state.Paused = true
        state.PausedAt = os.clock()
        pauseBtn.Text = "▶"
        centerMsg.Text = "⏸  TẠM DỪNG\nNhấn P hoặc ▶ để tiếp tục"
        centerMsg.TextColor3 = C.NeonYellow
        centerMsg.TextSize = 22
        centerMsg.TextTransparency = 0
        centerMsg.Visible = true
    else
        local pausedFor = math.max(0, os.clock() - (state.PausedAt or os.clock()))
        state.EndTime += pausedFor
        state.LastHitTime += pausedFor
        -- Preserve target lifetime while paused, so targets do not instantly expire on resume.
        for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
            local spawnedAt = target:GetAttribute("SpawnTime")
            if target.Visible and spawnedAt then
                target:SetAttribute("SpawnTime", spawnedAt + pausedFor)
            end
        end
        state.Paused = false
        state.PausedAt = 0
        pauseBtn.Text = "Ⅱ"
        centerMsg.Visible = false
        updateHUD()
    end
    playSFX("Click")
end

pauseBtn.Activated:Connect(togglePause)
connectTracked(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed or not alive then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
        togglePause()
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and hud.Visible and state.Playing and not state.Finishing then
        exitGame()
    end
end)

for id, card in pairs(modeCards) do
	card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() playSFX("Click"); enterGame(id) end)
end
quitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if not state.Finishing then exitGame() end end)

-- TRAP
local function triggerTrap(target)
    if not state.Playing or state.Paused or state.Finishing then return end
    state.TrapsHit += 1
    state.Playing = false
    playSFX("Trap")
    screenShake(15)
    local flash = mk("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.TrapRed, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 500 }, screenGui)
    tween(flash, 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
    task.delay(0.6, function() if flash.Parent then flash:Destroy() end end)
    local abs = target.AbsolutePosition - arena.AbsolutePosition
    local cx = abs.X + target.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    local cy = abs.Y + target.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
    spawnBurst(cx, cy, C.TrapRed)
    spawnRipple(cx, cy, C.TrapRed)
    spawnPopup(cx, cy, "BẪY!", C.TrapRed)
    finishGame("trap", state.RoundId)
end

-- HIT logic
local function doCorrectHit(target)
	local now = os.clock()
	local spawn = target:GetAttribute("SpawnTime") or now
	local rt = now - spawn
	state.ReactionSum += rt
	state.ReactionCount += 1
	table.insert(state.ReactionList, rt)
	if now - state.LastHitTime <= CONFIG.ComboWindow then
		state.Combo += 1
	else
		state.Combo = 1
	end
	state.LastHitTime = now
	if state.Combo > state.BestCombo then state.BestCombo = state.Combo end
	local gained = 1 + math.floor(state.Combo / 5)
	state.Score += gained
	state.Hits += 1
	updateHUD()
	local abs = target.AbsolutePosition - arena.AbsolutePosition
	local cx = abs.X + target.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
	local cy = abs.Y + target.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
	local col = target.Core.BackgroundColor3
	spawnRipple(cx, cy, col)
	spawnBurst(cx, cy, col)
	spawnPopup(cx, cy, "+" .. gained, col)
	SFX.Hit.PlaybackSpeed = 1 + math.min(state.Combo, 15) * 0.05
	playSFX("Hit")
	screenShake(math.min(state.Combo, 8))
end

local function doWrongHit(x, y)
	state.Misses += 1
	state.Combo = 0
	updateHUD()
	playSFX("Wrong")
	spawnRipple(x, y, C.DangerRed)
	spawnPopup(x, y, "SAI SỐ!", C.DangerRed)
end

local function onHit(target)
    if not state.Playing or state.Paused or not target.Visible then return end
    -- Suppress duplicate Activated events while keeping fast, legitimate aim shots responsive.
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastTargetActivation < 0.035 then return end
    lastTargetActivation = now

	-- Chế độ SỐ: check số đúng/sai TRƯỚC khi xử lý
	if state.Mode == "Numbers" and not target:GetAttribute("IsTrap") then
		local clickedNum = target:GetAttribute("Number")
		local abs = target.AbsolutePosition - arena.AbsolutePosition
		local cx = abs.X + target.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
		local cy = abs.Y + target.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
		if clickedNum ~= state.TargetNumber then
		            doWrongHit(cx, cy)
            return
		end
		doCorrectHit(target)
        -- Refresh the live number set atomically (no yield during input handling).
        for i = 1, 4 do respawnTarget(targets[i], CONFIG.TargetSize * 0.9) end
        newNumberRound()
		return
	end

	-- Bẫy
	if target:GetAttribute("IsTrap") then
		triggerTrap(target)
		return
	end

	-- Các chế độ khác
	doCorrectHit(target)
	local baseSize = CONFIG.TargetSize
	if state.Mode == "Gridshot" then
		respawnTarget(target, baseSize)
	elseif state.Mode == "Flick" then
		respawnTarget(target, baseSize * 0.95)
    elseif state.Mode == "Tracking" then
        respawnTarget(target, baseSize * 0.9)
        if not target:GetAttribute("IsTrap") then
            modeRuntime.velocities[target] = { vx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 260, vy = (math.random() - 0.5) * 260 }
        else
            modeRuntime.velocities[target] = nil
        end
	end
end

for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
    t.Activated:Connect(function() onHit(t) end)
end

missDetector.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not state.Playing or state.Paused then return end
	state.Misses += 1
	state.Combo = 0
	updateHUD()
	playSFX("Miss")
	local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local abs = m - arena.AbsolutePosition
	spawnRipple(abs.X, abs.Y, C.DangerRed)
	spawnPopup(abs.X, abs.Y, "MISS", C.DangerRed)
end)

-- Runtime loop
connectTracked(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
    if not state.Playing or state.Paused then return end
    if os.clock() - state.LastHitTime > CONFIG.ComboWindow and state.Combo > 0 then
        state.Combo = 0
        updateHUD()
    end
    hudTime.Text = "⏱️ " .. state.TimeLeft
    hudTime.TextColor3 = state.TimeLeft <= 5 and C.DangerRed or C.NeonCyan

    for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
        if target.Visible and target:GetAttribute("SpawnTime") then
            local age = os.clock() - target:GetAttribute("SpawnTime")
            local isTrap = target:GetAttribute("IsTrap")
            if state.Mode == "Tracking" and not isTrap then
                local velocity = modeRuntime.velocities[target]
                if velocity then
                    local arenaSize = arena.AbsoluteSize
                    local x = (target:GetAttribute("PosX") or 0) + velocity.vx * dt
                    local y = (target:GetAttribute("PosY") or 0) + velocity.vy * dt
                    local radius = target.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
                    local maxX, maxY = math.max(radius + 10, arenaSize.X - radius - 10), math.max(radius + 10, arenaSize.Y - radius - 10)
                    if x < radius + 10 or x > maxX then velocity.vx = -velocity.vx; x = math.clamp(x, radius + 10, maxX) end
                    if y < radius + 10 or y > maxY then velocity.vy = -velocity.vy; y = math.clamp(y, radius + 10, maxY) end
                    target:SetAttribute("PosX", x); target:SetAttribute("PosY", y)
                    target.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
                end
                target.LifeRing.UIStroke.Transparency = 1
            else
                local remaining = CONFIG.TargetLifetime - age
                if remaining <= 0 then
                    if not isTrap then
                        state.Misses += 1
                        state.Combo = 0
                        updateHUD()
                        playSFX("Miss")
                    end
                    local baseSize = CONFIG.TargetSize
                    local size = state.Mode == "Numbers" and baseSize * 0.9 or (state.Mode == "Flick" and baseSize * 0.95 or baseSize)
                    respawnTarget(target, size)
                    if state.Mode == "Tracking" then
                        if not target:GetAttribute("IsTrap") then
                            modeRuntime.velocities[target] = { vx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 260, vy = (math.random() - 0.5) * 260 }
                        else
                            modeRuntime.velocities[target] = nil
                        end
                    elseif state.Mode == "Numbers" then
                        newNumberRound()
                    end
                else
                    local pct = math.clamp(remaining / CONFIG.TargetLifetime, 0, 1)
                    target.LifeRing.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8 + pct * 0.5, 0.8 + pct * 0.5)
                    target.LifeRing.UIStroke.Transparency = 0.2 + (1 - pct) * 0.5
                    target.LifeRing.UIStroke.Color = isTrap and C.TrapRed or (pct > 0.4 and C.NeonYellow or C.DangerRed)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Timer uses a monotonic deadline so scheduler delays do not accumulate as drift.
task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        task.wait(0.05)
        if alive and state.Playing and not state.Paused and not state.Finishing then
            local remaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(state.EndTime - os.clock()))
            if remaining ~= state.TimeLeft then
                state.TimeLeft = remaining
                updateHUD()
                if remaining <= 5 and remaining > 0 then
                    centerMsg.Text = tostring(remaining)
                    centerMsg.TextColor3 = C.DangerRed
                    centerMsg.TextSize = 44
                    centerMsg.TextTransparency = 0
                    centerMsg.Visible = true
                    tween(centerMsg, 0.8, { TextTransparency = 1 })
                end
            end
            if remaining <= 0 then
                playSFX("End")
                finishGame("time", state.RoundId)
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function refreshLeaderboard()
	for _, ch in ipairs(lbContainer:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end
	end
	for i, entry in ipairs(session.Leaderboard) do
		local row = mk("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundColor3 = i == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(70, 55, 20) or C.CardBot, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 5 }, lbContainer)
		corner(row, 5)
		mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = "#" .. i, TextColor3 = i == 1 and C.NeonYellow or C.TextDim, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
		mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = entry.mode, TextColor3 = C.NeonCyan, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
		mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0, 0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = entry.score, TextColor3 = C.TextWhite, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
		mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0, 0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = string.format("%.1f%%", entry.accuracy), TextColor3 = C.SuccessGreen, TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
		mk("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 0), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, Text = math.floor(entry.avgRT) .. "ms", TextColor3 = C.NeonPink, TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 6 }, row)
	end
end

local function addLeaderboardEntry(entry)
	table.insert(session.Leaderboard, entry)
	table.sort(session.Leaderboard, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
	while #session.Leaderboard > 10 do table.remove(session.Leaderboard) end
	refreshLeaderboard()
end

finishGame = function(reason, roundId)
    reason = reason or "time"
    roundId = roundId or state.RoundId
    if not alive or roundId ~= state.RoundId or state.Finishing then return end

    state.Finishing = true
    state.Playing = false
    state.Paused = false
    state.PausedAt = 0
    pauseBtn.Text = "Ⅱ"
    clearAllTargets()
    promptLabel.Visible = false

    local total = state.Hits + state.Misses
    local accuracy = total > 0 and (state.Hits / total * 100) or 0
    local avgRT = state.ReactionCount > 0 and (state.ReactionSum / state.ReactionCount * 1000) or 0
    local bestRT, worstRT = math.huge, 0
    for _, reaction in ipairs(state.ReactionList) do
        if reaction < bestRT then bestRT = reaction end
        if reaction > worstRT then worstRT = reaction end
    end
    if bestRT == math.huge then bestRT = 0 end
    bestRT *= 1000
    worstRT *= 1000

    session.Games += 1
    session.Best = math.max(session.Best, state.Score)
    session.TotalHits += state.Hits
    session.TotalMisses += state.Misses
    session.TotalRT += state.ReactionSum
    session.TotalRTHits += state.ReactionCount
    if reason ~= "trap" and state.TrapsHit == 0 then session.Survived += 1 end

    -- Lifetime/career stats drive the progressively harder achievement ladder.
    career.Games += 1
    career.BestScore = math.max(career.BestScore, state.Score)
    career.BestCombo = math.max(career.BestCombo, state.BestCombo)
    career.TotalHits += state.Hits
    career.TotalAttempts += total
    career.TotalRT += state.ReactionSum
    career.TotalRTHits += state.ReactionCount
    if reason ~= "trap" and state.TrapsHit == 0 then career.CleanRuns += 1 end

    for _, attemptsRequired in ipairs({10, 25, 50, 100}) do
        if total >= attemptsRequired then
            local key = tostring(attemptsRequired)
            career.AccuracyBestByAttempts[key] = math.max(career.AccuracyBestByAttempts[key] or 0, accuracy)
        end
    end
    for _, samplesRequired in ipairs({5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 150}) do
        if state.ReactionCount >= samplesRequired then
            local key = tostring(samplesRequired)
            local oldBest = career.ReactionBestBySamples[key] or 0
            if oldBest == 0 or avgRT < oldBest then career.ReactionBestBySamples[key] = avgRT end
        end
    end

    addLeaderboardEntry({ score = state.Score, accuracy = accuracy, avgRT = avgRT, mode = state.Mode, time = os.time() })
    sessGamesVal.Text = tostring(session.Games)
    sessBestVal.Text = tostring(session.Best)
    local attempts = session.TotalHits + session.TotalMisses
    local totalAcc = attempts > 0 and (session.TotalHits / attempts * 100) or 0
    sessAvgAccVal.Text = string.format("%.1f%%", totalAcc)
    local totalAvgRT = session.TotalRTHits > 0 and (session.TotalRT / session.TotalRTHits * 1000) or 0
    sessAvgRTVal.Text = math.floor(totalAvgRT) .. "ms"
    checkAchievements()

    if reason == "trap" then
        centerMsg.Text = string.format("💥 BẪY  /  KẾT THÚC\nĐiểm: %d  •  Chính xác: %.1f%%\nCombo tốt nhất: x%d", state.Score, accuracy, state.BestCombo)
        centerMsg.TextColor3 = C.TrapRed
    else
        centerMsg.Text = string.format("🏁 KẾT THÚC\nĐiểm: %d  •  CX: %.1f%%\nCombo: x%d  •  RT TB: %dms\nRT tốt: %dms  •  RT tệ: %dms", state.Score, accuracy, state.BestCombo, math.floor(avgRT), math.floor(bestRT), math.floor(worstRT))
        centerMsg.TextColor3 = C.TextWhite
    end
    centerMsg.TextSize = 18
    centerMsg.TextTransparency = 0
    centerMsg.Visible = true
    local duration = reason == "trap" and 3 or 5
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if not alive or roundId ~= state.RoundId then return end
        centerMsg.Visible = false
        exitGame()
    end)
end

-- Hold and drag the launcher to reposition it. A short tap reopens the panel.
local launcherDragging = false
local launcherDidMove = false
local launcherStartInput = nil
local launcherStartPointer = nil
local launcherStartPosition = nil
floatToggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
    end
    if not floatToggle.Visible then return end
    launcherDragging = true
    launcherDidMove = false
    launcherStartInput = input
    launcherStartPointer = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    launcherStartPosition = launcherPosition or Vector2.new(toolbar.Position.X.Offset, toolbar.Position.Y.Offset)
end)
connectTracked(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
    if not launcherDragging then return end
    local isMouseMove = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    local isTouchMove = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    if not isMouseMove and not isTouchMove then return end
    local pointer = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    local delta = pointer - launcherStartPointer
    if delta.Magnitude >= 6 then launcherDidMove = true end
    if launcherDidMove then
        launcherPosition = clampLauncherPosition(launcherStartPosition + delta, camera.ViewportSize)
        launcherUserMoved = true
        toolbar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(launcherPosition.X, launcherPosition.Y)
    end
end)
connectTracked(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
    if not launcherDragging then return end
    local released = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input == launcherStartInput
        or (launcherStartInput and launcherStartInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
    if not released then return end
    local shouldOpen = not launcherDidMove
    launcherDragging = false
    launcherStartInput = nil
    launcherStartPointer = nil
    launcherStartPosition = nil
    launcherDidMove = false
    if shouldOpen and floatToggle.Visible and not state.Playing and not state.Finishing then
        main.Visible = true
        background.Visible = true
        floatToggle.Visible = false
        playSFX("BGM")
    end
end)

    local AimTrainer = {
        active = false,
        loading = false,
        lastError = nil,
        injectedGuis = {},     -- ScreenGui mới phát hiện sau khi load
        injectedSounds = {},   -- Sound mới phát hiện sau khi load
    }

    -- ─── Snapshot / detect GUI ───
    local function collectGuiRoots()
        local roots = {}
        pcall(function()
            local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then table.insert(roots, pg) end
        end)
        pcall(function() table.insert(roots, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
        if type(gethui) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                local h = gethui()
                if h then table.insert(roots, h) end
            end)
        end
        return roots
    end

    local function snapshotGuis()
        local set = {}
        for _, root in ipairs(collectGuiRoots()) do
            pcall(function()
                for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("ScreenGui") then set[d] = true end
                end
            end)
        end
        return set
    end

    local function detectNewGuis(baseline)
        local list = {}
        for _, root in ipairs(collectGuiRoots()) do
            pcall(function()
                for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("ScreenGui") and not baseline[d] then
                        table.insert(list, d)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        return list
    end

    -- ─── Snapshot / detect Sound ───
    local function snapshotSounds()
        local set = {}
        pcall(function()
            local ss = game:GetService("SoundService")
            for _, s in ipairs(ss:GetDescendants()) do
                if s:IsA("Sound") then set[s] = true end
            end
        end)
        return set
    end

    local function detectNewSounds(baseline)
        local list = {}
        pcall(function()
            local ss = game:GetService("SoundService")
            for _, s in ipairs(ss:GetDescendants()) do
                if s:IsA("Sound") and not baseline[s] then
                    table.insert(list, s)
                end
            end
        end)
        return list
    end

    -- ─── Load ───
    local function loadAimTrainer()
        if AimTrainer.active then return true end
        if AimTrainer.loading then return false, "Đang load..." end
        if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
            return false, "Executor thiếu loadstring"
        end
        local src = AIM_TRAINER_SOURCE
        if type(src) ~= "string" or #src < 50 then
            return false, "Chưa dán code Aim Trainer vào AIM_TRAINER_SOURCE"
        end
        if src:find("DÁN TOÀN BỘ CODE Aim Trainer", 1, true) then
            return false, "Bạn chưa thay placeholder bằng code thật"
        end

        AimTrainer.loading = true
        AimTrainer.lastError = nil

        local guiBaseline = snapshotGuis()
        local soundBaseline = snapshotSounds()

        local fn, compileErr
        local okCompile = pcall(function()
            fn = loadstring(src, "@Dungdx_AimTrainer_Embedded")
        end)
        if not okCompile or type(fn) ~= "function" then
            AimTrainer.loading = false
            AimTrainer.lastError = "Compile lỗi: " .. tostring(compileErr or "nil")
            return false, AimTrainer.lastError
        end

        local okRun, runErr = pcall(fn)
        if not okRun then
            AimTrainer.loading = false
            AimTrainer.lastError = "Runtime lỗi: " .. tostring(runErr):sub(1, 180)
            return false, AimTrainer.lastError
        end

        -- Chờ 1 nhịp cho script con defer-tạo GUI
        task.wait(0.35)

        AimTrainer.injectedGuis = detectNewGuis(guiBaseline)
        AimTrainer.injectedSounds = detectNewSounds(soundBaseline)
        AimTrainer.loading = false
        AimTrainer.active = true
        return true
    end

    -- ─── Unload ───
    local function unloadAimTrainer()
        if not AimTrainer.active and not AimTrainer.loading then
            return true
        end

        -- 1. Hook destroy nếu Aim Trainer tự đăng ký (dọn connection ẩn, v.v.)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G.DungdxAimTrainerDestroy) == "function" then
                _G.DungdxAimTrainerDestroy()
            end
        end)
        task.wait(0.08)

        -- 2. Gỡ ScreenGui Aim Trainer đã tạo
        for _, g in ipairs(AimTrainer.injectedGuis) do
            if g and g.Parent then
                pcall(function() g:Destroy() end)
            end
        end

        -- 3. Gỡ Sound Aim Trainer đã tạo
        for _, s in ipairs(AimTrainer.injectedSounds) do
            if s and s.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    s:Stop()
                    s:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end

        AimTrainer.injectedGuis = {}
        AimTrainer.injectedSounds = {}
        AimTrainer.active = false
        AimTrainer.loading = false
        return true
    end

    -- ─── UI ───
    local eAim = mSec(extendPage, "🎯 Aim Trainer Nexus Ultimate v11",
        "Bật = chạy · Tắt = gỡ sạch khỏi Extend (script chính vẫn sống)", 18)

    local aimStatusRow = mRow(eAim, 1)
    aimStatusRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56)

    local aimStatusLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", aimStatusRow)
    aimStatusLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20)
    aimStatusLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6)
    aimStatusLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    aimStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Tắt"
    aimStatusLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    aimStatusLbl.TextSize = 12
    aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Sub
    aimStatusLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local aimStatusSub = Instance.new("TextLabel", aimStatusRow)
    aimStatusSub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 16)
    aimStatusSub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 30)
    aimStatusSub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    aimStatusSub.Text = "Bật để chạy · Tắt để gỡ hoàn toàn"
    aimStatusSub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    aimStatusSub.TextSize = 10
    aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Sub
    aimStatusSub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    aimStatusSub.TextWrapped = true

    local aimToggleRef
    aimToggleRef = mTog(eAim, "Bật Aim Trainer",
        "Toggle điều khiển trọn vòng đời Aim Trainer", false, 2, function(v)
        if v then
            aimStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Đang load..."
            aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Accent
            aimStatusSub.Text = "Đang compile Aim Trainer..."
            aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Sub
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, err = loadAimTrainer()
                if not ok then
                    aimStatusLbl.Text = "Lỗi: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 90)
                    aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Danger
                    aimStatusSub.Text = "Không chạy được Aim Trainer"
                    aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Danger
                    warn("[Dungdx AimTrainer] " .. tostring(err))
                    task.defer(function()
                        if aimToggleRef and aimToggleRef.Sync then
                            aimToggleRef:Sync(false)
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                aimStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Đang chạy"
                aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Green
                aimStatusSub.Text = string.format(
                    "Đã đăng ký gỡ %d GUI khi tắt lại",
                    #AimTrainer.injectedGuis)
                aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Green
            end)
        else
            aimStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Đang tắt..."
            aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Accent
            aimStatusSub.Text = "Đang gỡ Aim Trainer khỏi phiên chơi..."
            aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Sub
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, err = unloadAimTrainer()
                if not ok then
                    aimStatusLbl.Text = "Lỗi khi tắt: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 80)
                    aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Danger
                    aimStatusSub.Text = "Một số thành phần có thể còn sót lại"
                    aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Danger
                    return
                end
                aimStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Tắt"
                aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Sub
                aimStatusSub.Text = "Đã gỡ hoàn toàn · Bật lại để chạy lại"
                aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Sub
            end)
        end
    end)

    mBtn(eAim, "🔄 Chạy lại từ đầu",
        "Tắt sạch rồi bật lại Aim Trainer (dùng khi GUI bị lỗi)", "Reload", 3, function()
        if AimTrainer.loading then return end
        aimStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Đang reload..."
        aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Accent
        task.spawn(function()
            unloadAimTrainer()
            task.wait(0.15)
            local ok, err = loadAimTrainer()
            if not ok then
                aimStatusLbl.Text = "Lỗi reload: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 80)
                aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Danger
                aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Danger
                if aimToggleRef and aimToggleRef.Sync then aimToggleRef:Sync(false) end
                return
            end
            aimStatusLbl.Text = "Trạng thái: Đang chạy (reload)"
            aimStatusLbl.TextColor3 = T.Green
            aimStatusSub.Text = "Reload thành công"
            aimStatusSub.TextColor3 = T.Green
            if aimToggleRef and aimToggleRef.Sync then aimToggleRef:Sync(true) end
        end)
    end)

local transparencyRecords = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function applyUITransparency()
    local amount = math.clamp(tonumber(state.uiTransparency) or 0, 0, 0.8)
    for i = #UI.transparencyBindings, 1, -1 do
        local record = UI.transparencyBindings[i]
        local object = record and record.object
        if not object or not object.Parent then
            table.remove(UI.transparencyBindings, i)
        else
            pcall(function()
                object.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(record.base + amount * (1 - record.base), 0, 1)
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function registerTheme(obj, property, role)
    if palette[role] then obj[property] = palette[role] end
    local binding = { object = obj, property = property, role = role }
    table.insert(themeBindings, binding)
    if role == "accent" or role == "accent2" then table.insert(rgbThemeBindings, binding) end
    if property == "BackgroundColor3" and obj:IsA("GuiObject") and not transparencyRecords[obj] then
        local base = obj.BackgroundTransparency
        if base < 0.995 then
            transparencyRecords[obj] = true
            table.insert(UI.transparencyBindings, { object = obj, base = base })
            if (state.uiTransparency or 0) > 0 then
                obj.BackgroundTransparency = base + state.uiTransparency * (1 - base)
            end
        end
    end
    return obj
end


local function make(className, parent, props)
    local obj = Instance.new(className)
    for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
        obj[key] = value
    end
    obj.Parent = parent
    return obj
end

-- Theme-aware gradients make surfaces feel layered without adding image assets or heavy effects.
local function addRoleGradient(obj, fromRole, toRole, rotation)
    if not obj or not obj.Parent then return nil end
    local gradient = make("UIGradient", obj, {
        Name = "DGThemeSurfaceGradient",
        Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette[fromRole] or palette.bg),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette[toRole] or palette.panel),
        }),
        Rotation = rotation or 0,
    })
    local record = { gradient = gradient, fromRole = fromRole, toRole = toRole, rotation = rotation or 0 }
    table.insert(themeGradients, record)
    if fromRole == "accent" or fromRole == "accent2" or toRole == "accent" or toRole == "accent2" then
        table.insert(rgbThemeGradients, record)
    end
    return gradient
end

local function addCorner(obj, radius)
    local corner = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
    if corner then
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)
        return corner
    end
    return make("UICorner", obj, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8) })
end

-- ⭐ UPGRADE: BackgroundDecoration — a capped dot field keeps the backdrop textured
-- without creating the 540 objects required by a literal 30x18 grid.
UI.backgroundDecoration = make("Frame", screenGui, {
    Name = "BackgroundDecoration", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ZIndex = 1,
})
do
    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
    local columns = math.clamp(math.floor(viewport.X / 160), 6, 7)
    local rows = 4
    for r = 1, rows do
        for c = 1, columns do
            local dot = make("Frame", UI.backgroundDecoration, {
                Name = "AmbientDot", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(c / (columns + 1), r / (rows + 1)),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), BackgroundColor3 = palette.accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.91, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ZIndex = 1,
            })
            addCorner(dot, 1)
            registerTheme(dot, "BackgroundColor3", "accent")
        end
    end
end


local function addStroke(obj, color, thickness, transparency, gradientAccent)
    local stroke = make("UIStroke", obj, {
        Color = color or palette.border,
        Thickness = thickness or 1,
        Transparency = transparency or 0,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
    })
    if gradientAccent then
        local gradient = make("UIGradient", stroke, {
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.accent),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.54, Color3.fromRGB(112, 74, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.accent2),
            }),
            Rotation = 0,
        })
        table.insert(accentGradients, gradient)
    end
    return stroke
end

local function label(parent, text, size, colorRole, pos, dimensions, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local obj = make("TextLabel", parent, {
        Name = opts.name or "Text",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = pos or UDim2.new(),
        Size = dimensions or UDim2.fromOffset(100, 20),
        Font = opts.font or Enum.Font.Gotham,
        Text = text or "",
        TextSize = size or 10,
        TextColor3 = palette[colorRole or "text"] or palette.text,
        TextXAlignment = opts.align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextYAlignment = opts.yAlign or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        TextWrapped = opts.wrapped or false,
        TextTruncate = opts.truncate and Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd or Enum.TextTruncate.None,
        RichText = false,
        Active = false,
        ZIndex = opts.z or 12,
    })
    if colorRole and palette[colorRole] then registerTheme(obj, "TextColor3", colorRole) end
    -- ⭐ UPGRADE: TypographyShadow — optional one-pixel depth for key headings.
    if opts.shadow then
        local shadow = make("TextLabel", parent, {
            Name = (opts.name or "Text") .. "Shadow", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new((pos or UDim2.new()).X.Scale, (pos or UDim2.new()).X.Offset,
                (pos or UDim2.new()).Y.Scale, (pos or UDim2.new()).Y.Offset + 1),
            Size = dimensions or UDim2.fromOffset(100, 20), Font = opts.font or Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = text or "", TextSize = size or 10, TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            TextTransparency = 0.42, TextXAlignment = opts.align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = opts.yAlign or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, TextWrapped = opts.wrapped or false,
            TextTruncate = opts.truncate and Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd or Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            RichText = false, Active = false, ZIndex = math.max(1, (opts.z or 12) - 1),
        })
        shadow:SetAttribute("DGTypographyShadow", true)
        local function syncShadow()
            if not shadow.Parent or not obj.Parent then return end
            shadow.Text = obj.Text
            shadow.TextSize = obj.TextSize
            shadow.Font = obj.Font
            shadow.TextWrapped = obj.TextWrapped
            shadow.TextTruncate = obj.TextTruncate
            shadow.TextXAlignment = obj.TextXAlignment
            shadow.TextYAlignment = obj.TextYAlignment
            shadow.Size = obj.Size
            shadow.Position = UDim2.new(obj.Position.X.Scale, obj.Position.X.Offset,
                obj.Position.Y.Scale, obj.Position.Y.Offset + 1)
        end
        for _, property in ipairs({ "Text", "TextSize", "Font", "TextWrapped", "TextTruncate", "TextXAlignment", "TextYAlignment", "Size", "Position" }) do
            obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(syncShadow)
        end
    end
    return obj
end

-- ⭐ UPGRADE: addRipple — touch/mouse feedback made from native GUI geometry only.
local function addRipple(btn, input)
    if not btn or not btn.Parent then return end
    local absoluteSize = btn.AbsoluteSize
    local maxDimension = math.max(absoluteSize.X, absoluteSize.Y, 12)
    local x, y = absoluteSize.X / 2, absoluteSize.Y / 2
    if input and input.Position then
        x = math.clamp(input.Position.X - btn.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, absoluteSize.X)
        y = math.clamp(input.Position.Y - btn.AbsolutePosition.Y, 0, absoluteSize.Y)
    end
    local diameter = maxDimension * 2
    local ripple = make("Frame", btn, {
        Name = "DGRipple", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = palette.accent,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.42, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false,
        ZIndex = btn.ZIndex + 5,
    })
    addCorner(ripple, math.ceil(diameter))
    local gradient = make("UIGradient", ripple, {
        Color = ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.accent2) }),
        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        }), Rotation = 35,
    })
    table.insert(accentGradients, gradient)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(ripple, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    })
    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        if ripple and ripple.Parent then ripple:Destroy() end
        for i = #accentGradients, 1, -1 do
            if accentGradients[i] == gradient then
                table.remove(accentGradients, i)
                break
            end
        end
    end)
    tween:Play()
end

local function button(parent, text, pos, dimensions, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local obj = make("TextButton", parent, {
        Name = opts.name or "Button",
        Position = pos,
        Size = dimensions,
        BackgroundColor3 = palette[opts.bgRole or "surface"] or palette.surface,
        BackgroundTransparency = opts.transparency == nil and 0 or opts.transparency,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        Text = text or "",
        Font = opts.font or Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = opts.textSize or 10,
        TextColor3 = palette[opts.textRole or "text"] or palette.text,
        TextWrapped = false,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        ZIndex = opts.z or 12,
        Active = true,
    })
    if opts.corner ~= false then addCorner(obj, opts.radius or 7) end
    local hoverStroke
    local baseStrokeThickness, baseStrokeTransparency
    if opts.stroke then
        local strokeRole = opts.strokeRole or "border"
        hoverStroke = addStroke(obj, palette[strokeRole], opts.strokeWidth or 1, opts.strokeTransparency or 0, opts.gradientStroke or false)
        registerTheme(hoverStroke, "Color", strokeRole)
        baseStrokeThickness = hoverStroke.Thickness
        baseStrokeTransparency = hoverStroke.Transparency
    end
    if opts.bgRole then registerTheme(obj, "BackgroundColor3", opts.bgRole) end
    if opts.textRole then registerTheme(obj, "TextColor3", opts.textRole) end
    if opts.gradientFill and opts.bgRole then
        -- ⭐ UPGRADE: ButtonDepthGradient — restrained surface-to-background shading.
        addRoleGradient(obj, opts.bgRole, "bg", 90)
    end

    -- ⭐ UPGRADE: MicroAnimations — scale feedback does not alter layout geometry.
    local motionScale
    local scaleTween
    if not opts.noMotion and opts.motionScale ~= false then
        obj.ClipsDescendants = true
        motionScale = make("UIScale", obj, { Name = "DGMicroScale", Scale = 1 })
        local function animateScale(target, duration, style, direction)
            if not motionScale or not motionScale.Parent then return end
            if scaleTween then scaleTween:Cancel() end
            scaleTween = TweenService:Create(motionScale, TweenInfo.new(duration, style, direction), { Scale = target })
            scaleTween:Play()
        end
        obj.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            animateScale(1.04, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        end)
        obj.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            animateScale(1, 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        end)
        obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                animateScale(0.96, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                if opts.ripple ~= false then addRipple(obj, input) end
            end
        end)
        obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                animateScale(1, 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
            end
        end)
    end

    if not opts.noMotion and hoverStroke then
        local strokeTween
        local function animateStroke(transparency, thickness)
            if not hoverStroke or not hoverStroke.Parent then return end
            if strokeTween then strokeTween:Cancel() end
            strokeTween = TweenService:Create(hoverStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.11, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Transparency = transparency, Thickness = thickness,
            })
            strokeTween:Play()
        end
        obj.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            animateStroke(math.max(0, (baseStrokeTransparency or 0) - 0.12), (baseStrokeThickness or 1) + 0.15)
        end)
        obj.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            animateStroke(baseStrokeTransparency or 0, baseStrokeThickness or 1)
        end)
        obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                animateStroke(math.max(0, (baseStrokeTransparency or 0) - 0.18), (baseStrokeThickness or 1) + 0.25)
            end
        end)
        obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                animateStroke(baseStrokeTransparency or 0, baseStrokeThickness or 1)
            end
        end)
    end
    obj.Activated:Connect(function()
        if opts.onClick then opts.onClick(obj) end
    end)
    return obj
end

local function gradientFrame(parent, position, size, pair, radius, z)
    local f = make("Frame", parent, {
        Position = position, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = pair and pair[1] or palette.accent,
        BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = z or 13,
    })
    addCorner(f, radius or 9)
    make("UIGradient", f, {
        Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, pair and pair[1] or palette.accent),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, pair and pair[2] or palette.accent2),
        }),
        Rotation = 25,
    })
    return f
end

local function glyph(parent, text, pos, size, glyphSize, color, z)
    local g = make("TextLabel", parent, {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = pos, Size = size, Text = text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = glyphSize or 15,
        TextColor3 = color or palette.text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, TextWrapped = false,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None, Active = false, ZIndex = z or 15,
    })
    return g
end


-- Vector-style icons: draw from native Frames/UIStrokes so they do not depend on
-- rare Unicode glyphs that can render as tofu boxes on some Roblox devices.
local function markIconPart(obj)
    obj:SetAttribute("DGIconPart", true)
    if UI.drawingIconRole then
        obj:SetAttribute("DGIconColorRole", UI.drawingIconRole)
        if UI.iconColorBindings then table.insert(UI.iconColorBindings, obj) end
    end
    return obj
end

local function setIconColor(iconRoot, color)
    if not iconRoot then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(iconRoot:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:GetAttribute("DGIconPart") then
            if part:IsA("UIStroke") then
                part.Color = color
            elseif part:IsA("TextLabel") then
                part.TextColor3 = color
            elseif part:IsA("Frame") then
                part.BackgroundColor3 = color
            end
        end
    end
end

local function makeIconLine(parent, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, thickness, z)
    local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
    local length = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
    local line = make("Frame", parent, {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2 - length / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2 - (thickness or 1.5) / 2),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, length), thickness or 1.5),
        Rotation = angle, BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = z or 20,
    })
    markIconPart(line)
    addCorner(line, math.max(1, (thickness or 1.5) / 2))
    return line
end

local function makeIconDot(parent, x, y, diameter, color, z)
    local dot = make("Frame", parent, {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter),
        BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 20,
    })
    addCorner(dot, diameter / 2)
    markIconPart(dot)
    return dot
end

local function makeIconRing(parent, x, y, diameter, color, thickness, z)
    local ring = make("Frame", parent, {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 20,
    })
    addCorner(ring, diameter / 2)
    local stroke = make("UIStroke", ring, {
        Color = color, Thickness = thickness or 1.2,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
    })
    markIconPart(stroke)
    return ring
end

local function drawIcon(parent, kind, position, size, color, z)
    local width = math.max(8, size.X.Offset + size.X.Scale * (parent.AbsoluteSize.X or 0))
    local height = math.max(8, size.Y.Offset + size.Y.Scale * (parent.AbsoluteSize.Y or 0))
    local previousIconRole = UI.drawingIconRole
    UI.drawingIconRole = nil
    for _, role in ipairs({ "text", "muted", "accent", "accent2", "danger", "border" }) do
        if palette[role] and color == palette[role] then
            UI.drawingIconRole = role
            break
        end
    end
    local unit = math.min(width, height) / 16
    local ox, oy = (width - 16 * unit) / 2, (height - 16 * unit) / 2
    local function px(v) return ox + v * unit end
    local function py(v) return oy + v * unit end
    local root = make("Frame", parent, {
        Name = "VectorIcon_" .. kind, Position = position, Size = size,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = z or 18,
    })
    -- The drawing parts live inside a positioned icon canvas; local coordinates are
    -- translated so a tall navigation hitbox still centers a square glyph.
    local canvas = root
    local function line2(x1, y1, x2, y2, thick)
        local function Lx(v) return px(v) end
        local function Ly(v) return py(v) end
        return makeIconLine(canvas, Lx(x1), Ly(y1), Lx(x2), Ly(y2), color, math.max(1, (thick or 1.35) * unit), z)
    end
    local function dot2(x, y, d)
        return makeIconDot(canvas, px(x), py(y), math.max(1, d * unit), color, z)
    end
    local function ring2(x, y, d, thick)
        return makeIconRing(canvas, px(x), py(y), math.max(5, d * unit), color, math.max(1, (thick or 1.2) * unit), z)
    end

    if kind == "music" or kind == "vinyl" then
        -- Vinyl record fallback: dark platter, concentric grooves, label and spindle.
        -- Everything is drawn with GUI geometry instead of a font glyph.
        local discSize = 14 * unit
        local disc = make("Frame", canvas, {
            Name = "VinylRecord",
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(1), py(1)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(discSize, discSize),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 10, 24), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 18,
        })
        addCorner(disc, discSize / 2)
        make("UIGradient", disc, { Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(31, 35, 62)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, Color3.fromRGB(8, 11, 25)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(23, 26, 48)),
        }), Rotation = 35 })
        local edge = make("UIStroke", disc, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(91, 105, 153), Thickness = math.max(1, 0.65 * unit), Transparency = 0.1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
        registerTheme(edge, "Color", "border")
        local function groove(scale, strokeColor, transparency, thickness)
            local side = discSize * scale
            local circle = make("Frame", disc, {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(side, side), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (z or 18) + 1,
            })
            addCorner(circle, side / 2)
            local line = make("UIStroke", circle, { Color = strokeColor, Thickness = math.max(1, thickness * unit), Transparency = transparency, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
            registerTheme(line, "Color", "border")
        end
        groove(0.78, Color3.fromRGB(74, 83, 123), 0.28, 0.48)
        groove(0.60, Color3.fromRGB(60, 69, 106), 0.18, 0.48)
        groove(0.42, Color3.fromRGB(85, 91, 128), 0.3, 0.42)
        local sheen = make("Frame", disc, {
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.max(1, 0.42 * unit), 0.12, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, 0.85 * unit), math.max(2, 2.8 * unit)),
            Rotation = 18, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(172, 188, 239),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.22, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (z or 18) + 2,
        })
        addCorner(sheen, math.max(1, unit))
        local labelSize = discSize * 0.32
        local centerLabel = make("Frame", disc, {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(labelSize, labelSize), BackgroundColor3 = palette.accent,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (z or 18) + 3,
        })
        addCorner(centerLabel, labelSize / 2); markIconPart(centerLabel)
        registerTheme(centerLabel, "BackgroundColor3", "accent")
        local centerGradient = make("UIGradient", centerLabel, { Color = ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, palette.accent2), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, palette.accent) }), Rotation = 45 })
        table.insert(accentGradients, centerGradient)
        local spindle = make("Frame", disc, {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1.5, 1.3 * unit), math.max(1.5, 1.3 * unit)),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(238, 242, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (z or 18) + 4,
        })
        addCorner(spindle, 4)
    elseif kind == "user" then
        -- Neutral user silhouette used only while the requested avatar thumbnail loads.
        ring2(5.1, 1.4, 5.8, 1.35)
        line2(3.0, 14.0, 3.0, 12.0, 1.45)
        line2(3.0, 12.0, 4.8, 10.0, 1.45)
        line2(4.8, 10.0, 6.3, 9.2, 1.45)
        line2(6.3, 9.2, 9.7, 9.2, 1.45)
        line2(9.7, 9.2, 11.2, 10.0, 1.45)
        line2(11.2, 10.0, 13.0, 12.0, 1.45)
        line2(13.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, 1.45)
        line2(3.0, 14.0, 13.0, 14.0, 1.45)
    elseif kind == "heart" then
        -- Heart outline built from rounded vector strokes (no Unicode fallback).
        line2(8, 13.8, 2.8, 8.7, 1.55)
        line2(2.8, 8.7, 2.2, 6.1, 1.55)
        line2(2.2, 6.1, 3.5, 3.7, 1.55)
        line2(3.5, 3.7, 5.8, 3.1, 1.55)
        line2(5.8, 3.1, 8, 5.1, 1.55)
        line2(8, 5.1, 10.2, 3.1, 1.55)
        line2(10.2, 3.1, 12.5, 3.7, 1.55)
        line2(12.5, 3.7, 13.8, 6.1, 1.55)
        line2(13.8, 6.1, 13.2, 8.7, 1.55)
        line2(13.2, 8.7, 8, 13.8, 1.55)
    elseif kind == "clock" then
        ring2(2, 2, 12, 1.25); line2(8, 4.3, 8, 8); line2(8, 8, 11, 9.7)
    elseif kind == "grid" then
        for _, p in ipairs({ {2,2}, {9,2}, {2,9}, {9,9} }) do
            local square = make("Frame", canvas, {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(p[1]), py(p[2])), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(3, 5 * unit), math.max(3, 5 * unit)),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 18,
            })
            addCorner(square, math.max(1, unit)); markIconPart(make("UIStroke", square, { Color = color, Thickness = math.max(1, 1.15 * unit) }))
        end
    elseif kind == "settings" then
        -- Compact gear: even teeth and a clean double-ring center remain legible at 13 px.
        ring2(4.3, 4.3, 7.4, 1.2)
        ring2(6.2, 6.2, 3.6, 1.15)
        line2(8, 0.9, 8, 3.1, 1.25); line2(8, 12.9, 8, 15.1, 1.25)
        line2(0.9, 8, 3.1, 8, 1.25); line2(12.9, 8, 15.1, 8, 1.25)
        line2(2.4, 2.4, 4.0, 4.0, 1.15); line2(12.0, 12.0, 13.6, 13.6, 1.15)
        line2(12.0, 4.0, 13.6, 2.4, 1.15); line2(2.4, 13.6, 4.0, 12.0, 1.15)
    elseif kind == "pin" then
        line2(5, 2.5, 11, 2.5, 1.35); line2(6, 2.5, 6, 6.8, 1.35)
        line2(10, 2.5, 10, 6.8, 1.35); line2(6, 6.8, 10, 6.8, 1.35)
        line2(8, 6.8, 8, 13.8, 1.45); line2(8, 13.8, 7.0, 12.5, 1.15)
    elseif kind == "edit" then

    elseif kind == "crown" then
        line2(2, 5, 4, 11); line2(4, 11, 12, 11); line2(12, 11, 14, 5)
        line2(2, 5, 6, 8); line2(6, 8, 8, 3); line2(8, 3, 10, 8); line2(10, 8, 14, 5); line2(4, 13, 12, 13)
        dot2(1, 3.7, 2.6); dot2(6.7, 1.5, 2.6); dot2(12.7, 3.7, 2.6)

        local leftCup = make("Frame", canvas, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(1), py(8)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2, 3 * unit), math.max(4, 5 * unit)), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 18 })

        addCorner(rightCup, unit); markIconPart(rightCup)
    elseif kind == "pulse" then

    elseif kind == "spark" then
        line2(8, 1.5, 8, 14.5); line2(1.5, 8, 14.5, 8); line2(3.2, 3.2, 12.8, 12.8); line2(3.2, 12.8, 12.8, 3.2)
        dot2(6.3, 6.3, 3.4)
    elseif kind == "shuffle" then

        line2(2, 12, 5, 12); line2(5, 12, 11, 4); line2(11, 4, 14, 4)
        line2(11.5, 1.8, 14.5, 4); line2(14.5, 4, 11.5, 6.2)

        line2(13, 11, 4, 11); line2(4, 11, 6, 9); line2(4, 11, 6, 13)
        line2(3, 5, 2, 6.5); line2(13, 11, 14, 9.5)
    elseif kind == "speaker" then
        local body = make("Frame", canvas, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(1.5), py(6)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2, 3 * unit), math.max(4, 4 * unit)), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 18 })
        addCorner(body, math.max(1, unit / 2)); markIconPart(body)
        line2(4.5, 6, 8.5, 3); line2(8.5, 3, 8.5, 13); line2(8.5, 13, 4.5, 10)
        line2(10.5, 5.5, 12, 7); line2(12, 7, 12, 9); line2(12, 9, 10.5, 10.5)
        line2(12.3, 3.5, 14.2, 6); line2(14.2, 6, 14.2, 10); line2(14.2, 10, 12.3, 12.5)
    elseif kind == "previous" then
        line2(4, 3, 4, 13, 1.6); line2(12, 4, 6, 8); line2(6, 8, 12, 12)
    elseif kind == "next" then
        line2(12, 3, 12, 13, 1.6); line2(4, 4, 10, 8); line2(10, 8, 4, 12)
    elseif kind == "plusCircle" then

    elseif kind == "dynamic" then
        -- Compact player window + a small waveform, drawn from Roblox Frames/UIStrokes.
        local shell = make("Frame", canvas, {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(1.8), py(3)),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12.4 * unit, 10 * unit),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 18,
        })
        addCorner(shell, math.max(2, 2.5 * unit))
        local outline = make("UIStroke", shell, { Color = color, Thickness = math.max(1, 1.05 * unit), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
        markIconPart(outline)
        line2(4, 8, 5.2, 8); line2(5.2, 8, 6.3, 5.4); line2(6.3, 5.4, 7.7, 10.5)
        line2(7.7, 10.5, 9.2, 6.4); line2(9.2, 6.4, 10.4, 8); line2(10.4, 8, 12, 8)
    elseif kind == "window" then
        line2(3, 2.5, 13, 2.5); line2(13, 2.5, 13, 13.5)
        line2(13, 13.5, 3, 13.5); line2(3, 13.5, 3, 2.5)
        line2(3.5, 5.3, 12.5, 5.3, 1.1)
    elseif kind == "play" then
        -- Filled triangle from native frames. This remains legible at small touch-control sizes.
        for row = 0, 10 do
            local taper = 1 - math.abs(row - 5) / 5
            local barWidth = math.max(1, 8.2 * taper * unit)
            local barHeight = math.max(1, 1.02 * unit)
            local bar = make("Frame", canvas, {
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(4.8), py(3 + row) - barHeight / 2),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(barWidth, barHeight),
                BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 18,
            })
            markIconPart(bar)
            addCorner(bar, math.max(1, barHeight / 2))
        end
    elseif kind == "close" then
        line2(4, 4, 12, 12, 1.45); line2(12, 4, 4, 12, 1.45)
    end
    UI.drawingIconRole = previousIconRole
    return root
end

local function spinVinyl(iconRoot, seconds)
    if not iconRoot then return nil end
    for _, entry in ipairs(UI.vinylRoots) do
        if entry.root == iconRoot then return iconRoot end
    end
    table.insert(UI.vinylRoots, { root = iconRoot, seconds = seconds or 4.2 })
    return iconRoot
end

local function syncVinylSpins()
    local liveDiscs = {}
    for i = #UI.vinylRoots, 1, -1 do
        local entry = UI.vinylRoots[i]
        local iconRoot = entry and entry.root
        if not iconRoot or not iconRoot.Parent then
            table.remove(UI.vinylRoots, i)
        else
            local disc = iconRoot:FindFirstChild("VinylRecord", true)
            if disc and disc:IsA("GuiObject") then
                liveDiscs[disc] = true
                local tween = UI.vinylTweens[disc]
                if isPlaybackActive() and state.motion and state.visualizerStyle ~= "Wave" then
                    if not tween then
                        -- Start from the current angle and rotate one full turn per cycle;
                        -- pausing and resuming will not snap the record back to zero.
                        local startRotation = disc.Rotation % 360
                        tween = TweenService:Create(disc, TweenInfo.new(entry.seconds or 3.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false), { Rotation = startRotation + 360 })
                        UI.vinylTweens[disc] = tween
                        tween:Play()
                    end
                else
                    if tween then
                        pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
                        UI.vinylTweens[disc] = nil
                    end
                    -- Hold the platter at its exact current angle while paused.
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for disc, tween in pairs(UI.vinylTweens) do
        if not liveDiscs[disc] or not disc.Parent then
            pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
            UI.vinylTweens[disc] = nil
        end
    end
    -- Rotate only the circular center artwork while actual playback is active.
    -- The waveform bars remain anchored, so the ring itself stays stable and readable.
    for _, waveDisc in ipairs(UI.waveArtworkRoots or {}) do
        if waveDisc and waveDisc.Parent then
            local waveTween = UI.waveArtworkTweens[waveDisc]
            if state.visualizerStyle == "Wave" and state.motion and isPlaybackActive() then
                if not waveTween then
                    waveTween = TweenService:Create(waveDisc, TweenInfo.new(8.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false), { Rotation = waveDisc.Rotation + 360 })
                    UI.waveArtworkTweens[waveDisc] = waveTween
                    waveTween:Play()
                end
            elseif waveTween then
                pcall(function() waveTween:Cancel() end)
                UI.waveArtworkTweens[waveDisc] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    for waveDisc, tween in pairs(UI.waveArtworkTweens or {}) do
        if not waveDisc or not waveDisc.Parent then
            pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
            UI.waveArtworkTweens[waveDisc] = nil
        end
    end
    for _, badge in ipairs(UI.playingDiscBadges) do
        if badge and badge.Parent then badge.Visible = isPlaybackActive() and state.visualizerStyle ~= "Wave" end
    end
end

local function createPlayingDiscBadge(parent, position, size, z)
    local badge = make("Frame", parent, {
        Name = "PlayingVinylBadge", Position = position, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
        BackgroundColor3 = palette.bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
        BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, Visible = false, ZIndex = z or 24,
    })
    addCorner(badge, math.floor(size / 2))
    registerTheme(badge, "BackgroundColor3", "bg")
    local outline = addStroke(badge, palette.accent, 1.1, 0.02, true)
    registerTheme(outline, "Color", "accent")
    local discIcon = drawIcon(badge, "vinyl", UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), palette.accent, (z or 24) + 2)
    spinVinyl(discIcon, 2.8)
    table.insert(UI.playingDiscBadges, badge)
    return badge
end

local function createPlayPauseButton(parent, position, size, opts)
    local btn = button(parent, "", position, size, opts)
    local w, h = size.X.Offset, size.Y.Offset
    local iconSize = math.max(13, math.floor(math.min(w, h) * 0.52))
    local playGlyph = drawIcon(btn, "play", UDim2.new(0.5, -iconSize / 2 + 1, 0.5, -iconSize / 2), UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize), palette.text, (opts and opts.z or 12) + 1)
    local barHeight = math.max(8, math.floor(h * 0.39))
    local barWidth = math.max(2, math.floor(w * 0.07))
    local gap = math.max(3, math.floor(w * 0.09))
    local totalWidth = barWidth * 2 + gap
    local pause = make("Frame", btn, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -totalWidth / 2, 0.5, -barHeight / 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(totalWidth, barHeight), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = (opts and opts.z or 12) + 2 })
    local pauseLeft = make("Frame", pause, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(barWidth, barHeight), BackgroundColor3 = palette.text, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (opts and opts.z or 12) + 2 })
    local pauseRight = make("Frame", pause, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(barWidth + gap, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(barWidth, barHeight), BackgroundColor3 = palette.text, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (opts and opts.z or 12) + 2 })
    addCorner(pauseLeft, 2); addCorner(pauseRight, 2)
    registerTheme(pauseLeft, "BackgroundColor3", "text")
    registerTheme(pauseRight, "BackgroundColor3", "text")

    for i = 1, 3 do
        local dotSize = math.max(2, math.floor(math.min(w, h) * 0.09))
        local x, y
        if vertical then
            x = (w - dotSize) / 2
            y = h * (i / 4) - dotSize / 2
        else
            x = w * (i / 4) - dotSize / 2
            y = (h - dotSize) / 2

        local dot = make("Frame", btn, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dotSize, dotSize), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = ((opts and opts.z) or 12) + 1 })
        addCorner(dot, dotSize)
        registerTheme(dot, "BackgroundColor3", (opts and opts.textRole) or "muted")

    return btn

local function createMagnifier(parent, position, size, color, z)
    local group = make("Frame", parent, { Position = position, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ZIndex = z or 15 })
    local diameter = math.max(7, math.floor(math.min(size.X.Offset, size.Y.Offset) * 0.58))
    local circle = make("Frame", group, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (z or 15) })
    addCorner(circle, diameter)
    local iconColor = color or palette.muted
    local colorRole = (iconColor == palette.accent or iconColor == palette.accent2) and "accent" or "muted"
    local circleStroke = addStroke(circle, iconColor, 1.35, 0, false)
    registerTheme(circleStroke, "Color", colorRole)
    local handle = make("Frame", group, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter - 1, diameter - 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, math.max(4, size.Y.Offset * 0.31)), Rotation = -45, BackgroundColor3 = iconColor, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (z or 15) + 1 })
    registerTheme(handle, "BackgroundColor3", colorRole)
    addCorner(handle, 1)
    return group
end
